ενειλεω.def: ἐνειλέω fut. ήσω (= ἐνείλλω) 1. to wrap in: metaph.in Pass. to be engaged in or with, τοῖς πολεμίοις Plut. B. ἐνείλλω 1. to wrap up in a thing, c. dat., Thuc.

ενειμι.def: ἔνειμι (εἰμί sum) fut. -έσομαι I. to be in a place, c. dat., Hom., etc.: c. dat. pl. to be among, Hdt. 2. absol. to be there, be in abundance, Od., etc.; σίτου οὐκ ἐνόντος as there was no corn there, Thuc.; ἱερῶν τῶν ἐνόντων of the temples that were in the place, id. II. to be possible, Trag., etc. 2. impers. c. dat. pers. et inf. it is in one's power, one may or can, Soph., etc. 3. part. neut. ἐνόν absol. since it was in them, was possible, Luc. 4. τὰ ἐνόντα all things possible, Dem.

ενειρω.def: ἐνείρω to string on a thing, Pass., Hdt.

ενεκα.gloss: on account of, for the sake of, because of, for
ενεκα.def: ἕνεκα or -κεν I. prep. with gen., mostly after its case, Il., etc.: on account of, for the sake of, because of, for, Lat. gratia, id., etc. 2. as far as regards, as for, ἐμοῦ γε ἕνεκα as far as depends on me, Ar.; εἵνεκέν γε χρημάτων Hdt., etc. 3. pleon., ἀμφὶ σοὔνεκα Soph.; ὅσον ἀπὸ βοῆς ἕνεκα as far as shouting went, Thuc. II. as Conjunct., for οὕνεκα, because, Hhymn.

ενελαυνω.def: ἐνελαύνω fut. -ελάσω attic -ελῶ to drive in or into, c. dat., Il.

ενελισσω.def: ἐνελίσσω ionic εἰλ- fut. ξω to roll up in:—Mid. to wrap oneself in, Hdt.

ενεμεω.def: ἐνεμέω fut. έσω to vomit in or into, εἴς τι Hdt.

ενενηκονταετησ.def: ἐνενηκοντα-ετής, ές ninety years old, Luc.

ενεορταζω.def: ἐνεορτάζω fut. σω to keep holiday in, Plut.

ενεοσ.def: ἐνεός dumb, deaf and dumb, Xen.

ενεπαγομαι.def: ἐνεπάγομαι Mid. to make an irruption among, Aesop.

ενεπιορκεω.def: ἐνεπιορκέω to forswear oneself by a god, Aeschin.

ενεπω.gloss: to tell, tell of, relate, describe
ενεπω.def: ἐνέπω (a lengthd. form of ⁎ἔπω, εἰπεῖν,) 1. to tell, tell of, relate, describe, Hom., Trag.:—absol. to tell news or tales, Od. 2. simply to speak, Hes., Trag. 3. c. acc. et inf. to bid one do so and so, Soph. 4. to call so and so, ἐνν. τινὰ δοῦλον Eur. 5. = προσεννέπω, to address, τινά Soph.

ενεργαζομαι.def: ἐνεργάζομαι fut. σομαι 1. Dep. to make or produce in, c. dat., Xen., etc.:—aor1 ἐνειργάσθην in pass. sense, to be placed in, id. 2. to work for hire in a place, Hdt.; ἐνεργ. τῇ οὐσίᾳ to trade with the property, Dem.

ενεργεια.def: ἐνέργεια, ἡ, (from ἐνεργής) action, operation, energy, Arist.

ενεργεω.gloss: to be in action, to operate
ενεργεω.def: ἐνεργέω fut. ήσω (from ἐνεργής) to be in action, to operate, Arist.; so in Mid., NTest.

ενεργησ.def: ἐνεργής, ές (= ἐνεργός) of land, productive, Plut.

ενεργολαβεω.def: ἐνεργολαβέω fut. ήσω to make profit of a thing, Aeschin.

ενεργοσ.def: ἐν-εργός, όν (ἔργον) I. at work, working, active, busy, Hdt., etc.: of soldiers, ships, effective, fit for service, Thuc., Xen. II. of land, in work, productive, opp. to ἀργός, id.; ἐν. χρήματα capital which brings in a return, Dem. III. adv. ἐνεργῶς with activity, Xen.

ενερειδω.def: ἐνερείδω fut. σω to thrust in, fix in, τί τινι Od.:— Mid., ἐνερεισάμενος πέτρᾳ γόνυ having planted his own knee on the rock, Theocr.

ενερευγομαι.def: ἐνερεύγομαι Dep. with aor2 act. -ήρῠγον to belch on one, c. dat., Ar.

ενερθε.def: ἔνερθε before a vowel -θεν (from ἐν, ἔνεροι) (cf. ὑπέρ, ὕπερθε) I. adv., from beneath, up from below, Il., Aesch., Eur. 2. without sense of motion, beneath, below, Hom.; οἱ ἔνερθε θεοί the gods below, Lat. dii inferi, Il. II. as prep. with gen. beneath, below, Hom., Trag. 2. subject to, in the power of, Soph.

ενεροι.def: ἔνεροι (ἐν) Lat. inferi, those below, those beneath the earth, Il., Hes., Aesch.

ενερσισ.def: ἔνερσις, εως (ἐνείρω) a fitting in, fastening, Thuc.

ενερτεροσ.def: ἐνέρτερος, η, ον (comp. of ἔνεροι,) lower, of the world below, Il., Aesch.: c. gen. below, Il. Cf. νέρτερος.

ενεσια.def: ἐνεσία (ἐνίημι) a suggestion, κείνης ἐννεσίῃσι (epic dat. pl.) at her suggestion, Il.

ενετη.def: ἐνετή, ἡ, (ἐνετός) a pin, brooch, Il.

ενευδαιμονεω.def: ἐνευδαιμονέω fut. ήσω to be happy in one's life, Thuc.

ενευδοκιμεω.def: ἐνευδοκιμέω fut. ήσω to gain glory in another's ill fortune, Dem.

ενευδω.def: ἐνεύδω fut. -ευδήσω to sleep in or on a thing, c. dat., Od.

ενευλογεομαι.def: ἐνευλογέομαι Pass. to be blessed in one, c. dat., NTest.

ενευναιοσ.gloss: on which one sleeps, for sleeping on
ενευναιοσ.def: ἐν-εύναιος, ον (εὐνή) on which one sleeps, for sleeping on, Od.; ἐνεύναια, bed-furniture, id.

ενεχυραζω.def: ἐνεχυράζω fut. άσω (ἐνέχῠρον) 1. to take a pledge from one, τινός Lex ap. Dem. 2. c. acc. rei, to take in pledge, Dem., Aeschin.:—Pass. to have one's goods seized for debt, Ar.:—Mid. to have security given one, take it for oneself, id.

ενεχυρασια.gloss: a taking in pledge, a security, pledge
ενεχυρασια.def: ἐνεχῠρᾱσία, ἡ, a taking in pledge, a security, pledge, Plat.

ενεχυρον.def: ἐν-έχῠρον, ου, τό, (ἐχυρός) a pledge, surety, security, Hdt., Xen.; ἐν. τιθέναι τι to make a thing a pledge, put it in pawn, Ar.

ενεχω.def: ἐνέχω fut. -έξω or -σχήσω I. to hold within, χόλον ἐνέχειν τινί to lay up, cherish inward wrath at one, Hdt. II. Pass., with fut. and aor. mid., to be held, caught, entangled in a thing, c. dat., id., Xen.: metaph., ἐνέχεσθαι ἀπορίῃσιν Hdt.; ἐν κακῷ id.; ἐν θωύματι ἐνέσχετο was seized with wonder, id. 2. to be obnoxious, liable or subject to, ζημίᾳ, αἰτίᾳ Plat., etc. III. intr. to enter in, pierce, εἴς τι Xen. 2. to press upon, be urgent against, τινί NTest.

ενζευγνυμι.gloss: to yoke in, bind, involve in
ενζευγνυμι.def: ἐνζεύγνυμι fut. -ζεύξω I. to yoke in, bind, involve in misfortune, Aesch. II. to bind fast, Soph.

ενηβητηριον.def: ἐν-ηβητήριον, ου, τό, (ἡβάω) a place of amusement, Hdt.

ενηησ.def: ἐνηής, ές gen. ἐνηέος kind, gentle, Hom. (Perh. akin to ἀπηνής, προσηνής.)

ενηλατον.def: ἐνήλᾰτον, ου, τό, (ἐνελαύνω) I. anything driven in: as Subst., ἐνήλατα (sc. ξύλα), τά, the rounds of a ladder, which are fixed in the sides, Eur. II. ἀξόνων ἐνήλατα the pins driven into the axle, linchpins, id.

ενηλικοσ.gloss: of age, in the prime of manhood
ενηλικοσ.def: ἐνήλῐκος, ον of age, in the prime of manhood, Plut.

ενημαι.def: ἐνῆμαι properly perf. of ἐνέζομαι to be seated in, Od.

ενηνοθε.def: ἐνήνοθε (ἐνήνοθε, 3rd sg. perf. without any pres. ἐνέθω in use: only found in compds.) I. ἐπενήνοθε, of Thersites' head, ψεδνὴ ἐπ. λάχνη a thin coat of downy hair grew thereon, Il.; of a cloak, οὐλὴ ἐπενήνοθε λάχνη a thick pile was on it, id.; c. acc., of ambrosial unguent, οἷα θεοὺς ἐπενήνοθε such as is on the gods, Od. II. κατενήνοθε, to be over, lie upon, Hes., Hom.

ενθα.def: ἔνθα (ἐν) adv.: I. Demonstr. 1. of Place, there, Lat. ibi, Hom., etc.:—also with Verbs of motion, thither, Lat. illuc, id.; ἔνθα καὶ ἔνθα here and there, hither and thither, Lat. hic illic, huc illuc, id. 2. of Time, thereupon, then, just then, id., etc. II. Relat., 1. of Place, where, Lat. ubi, Il., etc.;c. gen., γαίας ἔνθα in that spot of earth in which, Soph.; ἔνθα πημάτων κυρῶ at what point of misery I am, Eur.: —with Verbs of motion, whither, Lat. quo, Soph. 2. of Time, when, Xen.; ἔστιν ἔνθα, Lat. est ubi, sometimes, Soph.

ενθαδε.def: ἐνθάδε I. of Place, thither, hither, Lat. illuc, huc, Od., etc. 2. in attic like ἔνθα, here or there, Lat. hic, Ar., etc.; οἱ ἐνθάδε those here, opp. to οἱ κάτω, Soph.; also the people of this country, id. II. of circumstances, in this case or state, Xen.; so, ἐνθάδ’ ἥκων having come to this point, Soph.; c. gen., ἐνθάδε τοῦ πάθους at this stage of my suffering, id. 2. of Time, here, now, id., Xen.

ενθαδι.def: ἐνθαδί attic strengthd. for ἐνθάδε, Ar.

ενθακεω.def: ἐνθακέω fut. ήσω to sit in or on a thing, c. dat., Soph.

ενθακησισ.def: ἐνθᾱ́κησις, εως a sitting in, ἡλίου ἐνθ. a seat in the sun, Soph.

ενθαπερ.def: ἔνθαπερ there where, where, stronger form of ἔνθα, Il., etc.: whither, Soph.

ενθαπτω.def: ἐνθάπτω fut. ψω to bury in a place: aor2 pass. ἐνετάφην Aeschin.

ενθεαζω.def: ἐνθεάζω fut. σω to be inspired, Hdt.

ενθεν.def: ἔνθεν (ἐν) adv.: I. Demonstr., 1. of Place, Lat. inde, thence, Hom.; ἔνθεν μὲν.., ἑτέρωθι δέ.., on the one side and the other, Od.; ἔνθεν καὶ ἔνθεν on this side and on that, Lat. hinc illinc, Hdt., etc.:— c. gen., ἔνθεν καὶ ἔνθεν τῶν τροχῶν on both sides of the wheels, Xen. 2. of Time, thereupon, thereafter, Il., Aesch. 3. of occasion, thence, from that point, Od. II. Relat., for ὅθεν, 1. of Place, Lat. unde, whence, from which, id., Soph. 2. of occasion, whence, like Lat. unde, Aesch., Eur. Hence

ενθενδε.def: ἐνθένδε 1. hence, from this quarter, Lat. hinc, Hom., attic; ἐνθένδ’ αὐτόθεν from this very city, Ar. 2. of Time or Consequence, from that time, Thuc.; ἐνθένδε or τοὐνθένδε, thereafter, Soph., Eur.; τἀνθένδε what followed, the event, id.

ενθεοσ.gloss: full of the god, inspired, possessed
ενθεοσ.def: ἔν-θεος, ον I. full of the god, inspired, possessed, Trag., Xen.:—c. gen. rei, ἔνθεος τέχνης gifted of heaven with prophetic art, Aesch. II. of divine frenzy, inspired by the god, id.

ενθερμαινω.def: ἐνθερμαίνω to heat:—Pass., ἐντεθέρμανται πόθῳ is heated by passion, Soph.

ενθεσισ.def: ἔνθεσις, εως (ἐντίθημι) a putting in: also a piece put in, a mouthful, Ar.

ενθεσμοσ.def: ἔν-θεσμος, ον lawful, like ἔννομος, Plut.

ενθετοσ.def: ἔνθετος, ον (ἐντίθημι) put in, implanted, Theogn.

ενθηροσ.gloss: full of wild beasts, infested by
ενθηροσ.def: ἔν-θηρος, ον (θήρ) I. full of wild beasts, infested by them, Eur. II. metaph. savage, wild, rough, Aesch.: untended, undressed, Soph.

ενθνησκω.def: ἐνθνήσκω fut. -θᾰνοῦμαι 1. to die in a place, Soph., Eur. 2. of the hand, to grow torpid in, τινί id.

ενθουσιαζω.def: ἐνθουσιάζω (ἔνθεος) to be inspired or possessed by the god, be rapt, be in ecstasy, Xen., Plat.:—c. dat., ἐνθουσιᾶν κακοῖς Eur.

ενθουσιαστικοσ.def: ἐνθουσιαστικός, ή, όν (from ἐνθουσιάζω) inspired, Plat., etc.

ενθρυπτοσ.def: ἔνθρυπτος, ον (θρύπτω) crumbled and put into liquid: τὰ ἔνθρυπτα sops, Dem.

ενθρωσκω.def: ἐνθρώσκω fut. -θοροῦμαι aor2 ἐνέθορον epic ἔνθορον to leap in, on, or among, c. dat., Il., Eur.:— λὰξ ἔνθορεν ἰσχίῳ leapt with his feet against his, Od.

ενθυμεομαι.gloss: to lay to heart, consider well, reflect on, ponder
ενθυμεομαι.def: ἐνθυμέομαι fut. -ήσομαι aor1 ἐνεθυμήθην perf. ἐντεθύμημαι (θυμός) 1. to lay to heart, consider well, reflect on, ponder, Aesch., Thuc., etc. b. c. gen., ἐνθυμεῖσθαί τινος to think much or deeply of a thing, id., Xen. c. foll. by a relative, as by ὅτι, to consider that, Ar., etc. d. with part., οὐκ ἐντεθύμηται ἐπαιρόμενος was not conscious that he was becoming excited, Thuc. 2. to take to heart, be hurt or angry at, τι Aesch., Dem. 3. to think out a thing, form a plan, Thuc. 4. to infer, conclude, Dem.

ενθυμημα.gloss: a thought, piece of reasoning, argument
ενθυμημα.def: ἐνθύμημα, ατος, τό, (from ἐνθῡμέομαι) I. a thought, piece of reasoning, argument, Soph., Aeschin. II. an invention, device, Xen.

ενθυμητεοσ.def: ἐνθῡμητέος, ον (from ἐνθυμέομαι) (verb. adj.) one must consider, Dem.

ενθυμια.def: ἐνθῡμία, ἡ, (from ἐνθυμέομαι) a scruple, misgiving, Thuc.

ενθυμιοσ.def: ἐν-θῡ́μιος, ον (θυμός) taken to heart, μή σοι ἐνθύμιος ἔστω take not much thought for him, Od.; ἐνθύμιόν οἱ ἐγένετο he had trouble of heart, Hdt.; τί δ’ ἐστί σοι τοῦτ’ ἐνθύμιον; what is 't that weighs upon thy heart? Soph.; ἐνθύμιον ποιεῖσθαί τι to have a scruple about it, Thuc.

ενθυμιστοσ.def: ἐν-θῡμιστός, ή, όν (= ἐνθύμιος) taken to heart, Hdt.

ενθωρακιζω.def: ἐνθωρακίζω fut. attic ιῶ to arm, equip with armour: part. perf. pass. ἐντεθωρακισμένος mailed, Xen.

ενιαυσιοσ.gloss: of a year, one year old
ενιαυσιοσ.def: ἐνιαύσιος, η, ον I. of a year, one year old, σῦς Od., Dem., etc. II. yearly, annual, year by year, Hdt.:—neut. pl. as adv., Hes. III. for a year, lasting a year, Eur., Thuc.; κἀνιαύσιος βεβώς gone, absent for a year, Soph. (from ἐνιαυτός)

ενιαυτοσ.gloss: any long period of time, a cycle, period
ενιαυτοσ.def: ἐνιαυτός, ὁ, (ἔνος = annus) I. any long period of time, a cycle, period, περιπλομένων ἐνιαυτῶν as times rolled on, Od.; ἐτῶν ἐνιαυτούς Ar. II. = ἔτος, a year, Hom., etc.; ἐνιαυτόν during a year, Od.; τοῦ ἐνιαυτοῦ every year, Xen.; εἰς ἐνιαυτόν for a year, Il.;— κατ’ ἐνιαυτόν for a year, Thuc.; or every year, attic

ενιαυω.def: ἐνιαύω fut. -ιαύσω to sleep among others, c. dat., Od.

ενιαχη.def: ἐνιαχῆ (ἔνιοι) in some places, Hdt.; c. gen. loci, id.

ενιαχου.gloss: in some places, here and there, now and then
ενιαχου.def: ἐνιαχοῦ (ἔνιοι) in some places, here and there, now and then, Plat.

ενιδροω.gloss: to sweat in, labour hard in
ενιδροω.def: ἐνιδρόω fut. ώσω to sweat in, labour hard in, Xen.

ενιδρυω.def: ἐνιδρύω fut. ύσω to set in a place:—Mid. to found or build for oneself, Hdt.:—Pass. to be placed or settled in a place, id.

ενιζω.def: ἐνίζω to sit in or on a seat, c. acc., Eur.; c. dat., Plat.

ενιημι.def: ἐνίημι fut. -ήσω aor1 -ῆκα epic -έηκα I. to send in or into, Hom. 2. to put in, implant, inspire, c. acc. rei et dat. pers., καί οἱ θάρσος ἐνὶ στήθεσσιν ἐνῆκε Il.; ἐνεὶς λύσσαν Eur. 3. reversely, c. acc. pers. et dat. rei, to plunge into, τὸν Ζεὺς ἐνέηκε πόνοισι Il. 4. generally, to throw in or upon, c. dat., Hom.:—of ships, to launch them into the sea, Od.:— metaph. to incite one to do a thing, c. inf., Mosch. 5. to send into the assembly, employ, Thuc. 6. to inject poison, Xen. II. intr. to press on, id.

ενικλαω.def: ἐνικλάω poet. for ἐγκ to break in, break off: metaph., ἐνικλᾶν ὅττι νοήσω to frustrate what I devise, Il.

ενιοι.def: ἔνιοι some, Lat. aliqui, = ἔστιν οἵ, Hdt., Xen., etc.

ενιοτε.def: ἐνίοτε for ἔνι ὅτε ἔστιν ὅτε, sometimes, Eur., etc.

ενιπη.def: ἐνῑπή, ἡ, (ἐνίπτω) a rebuke, reprof; also abuse, contumely, Hom.

ενιππευω.def: ἐνιππεύω fut. σω to ride in, Hdt.

ενιπτω.def: ἐνίπτω to reprove, upbraid, Lat. objurgo, Hom.

ενισσω.def: ἐνίσσω (collat. form of ἐνίπτω) to attack, reproach, Hom.; epic inf. ἐνισσέμεν Il.:—Pass., ἐνισσόμενος misused, id.

ενιστημι.def: ἐνίστημι I. Causal in pres., fut. and aor1 act., and in aor1 mid.:— to put, set, place in, ἐν λίθοις Xen.; ἐς τὰς χώρας Hdt. 2. aor1 mid. to begin, Dem. B. Pass., with aor2 perf., and plup. act.:— to be set in, to stand in a place, c. dat., Eur.; ἐν τῷ νηῷ Hdt. II. to be appointed, βασιλεὺς ἐνίστασθαι id. III. to be upon, to threaten, Lat. imminere, c. dat. pers., id.:—absol. to be at hand, begin, arise, Ar., Dem.:—of time, ὁ ἐνεστὼς πόλεμος the present war, Aeschin.; τὰ ἐνεστηκότα πράγματα present circumstances, Xen. IV. to stand in the way, resist, τινι Thuc.:—absol. to stand in the way, id.

ενισχω.def: ἐνίσχω (= ἐνέχω) Mid., ἐνίσχεσθαι τὴν φωνήν to keep in one's voice, Plut.:—Pass. to be held fast, Hdt., Xen.

ενναετηρ.def: ἐνναετήρ, ῆρος, (ἐνναίω) an inmate, inhabitant, Anth.

ενναετηρισ.def: ἐννα-ετηρίς, ίδος (ἔτος) a period of nine years, Plat.

ενναετηροσ.def: ἐννα-έτηρος, ον (ἔτος) (= ἐνναετής) nine years old, Hes.

ενναετησ.def: ἐννα-ετής, ές (ἔτος) nine years old, Theocr.:—neut. ἐννάετες, as adv. for nine years, Hes.:—fem. ἐνναέτις

ενναιω.def: ἐνναίω to dwell in a place, c. dat., Eur.; ἐνν. ἐκεῖ Soph.:—c. acc. loci, to inhabit, Mosch.

ενναυπηγεομαι.gloss: to have ships built in it
ενναυπηγεομαι.def: ἐνναυπηγέομαι Pass. to have ships built in it, of a place, Thuc.

εννεα.def: ἐννέα indecl. nine, Lat. novem, Hom., etc.

εννεαβοιοσ.def: ἐννεά-βοιος, ον (βοῦς) worth nine beeves, Il.

εννεακαιδεκαμηνοσ.def: ἐννεακαιδεκά-μηνος, ον (μήν) nineteen months old, Anth.

εννεακαιδεκετησ.def: ἐννεα-και-δεκ-ετής, ές (ἔτος) eleven years old, Anth.

εννεακρουνοσ.def: ἐννεά-κρουνος, ον with nine springs, name of a well at Athens, also called Καλλιρρόη, Hdt., Thuc.

εννεαλινοσ.def: ἐννεά-λῐνος, ον (λίνον) of nine threads, Xen.

εννεαμηνοσ.def: ἐννεά-μηνος, ον (μήν) of or in nine months, Hdt.

εννεαπηχυσ.def: ἐννεάπηχυς nine cubits broad, or long, Il.

εννεασ.def: ἐννεάς, άδος, (ἐννέα) a body of nine, Theocr.

εννεαχιλοι.def: ἐννεάχιλοι epic for ἐνάκις χίλιοι nine thousand, Il.

εννεοργυιοσ.def: ἐννε-όργυιος, ον (ὄργυια) nine fathoms long, Od.

εννεοσσευω.def: ἐννεοσσεύω attic ἐν-νεοττεύω fut. εύσω I. to hatch young in a place, Ar. II. c. acc. to hatch as in a nest, Plat.

εννευω.gloss: to make signs to, to ask by signs
εννευω.def: ἐννεύω fut. σω to make signs to, to ask by signs, NTest.

εννεωροσ.def: ἐννέ-ωρος, ον (ὥρα) 1. of or for nine years, Hom. 2. nine years old. Od.

εννημαρ.def: ἐννῆμαρ epic adv. for nine days, Il.

εννοεω.gloss: to have in one's thoughts, to think, consider, reflect
εννοεω.def: ἐννοέω fut. ήσω ionic aor1 part. ἐννώσας perf. ἐννένωκα attic Dep. ἐννοοῦμαι with aor. pass. ἐνενοήθην ionic 3rd sg. plup. ἐννένωτο I. to have in one's thoughts, to think, consider, reflect, Hdt., Plat.; ἐνν. μή.., to be anxious lest.., Xen. 2. c. acc. to think or reflect upon, consider, Hdt., Soph.; ἐννοεῖν περί τινος Eur. 3. c. gen. to have thought of a thing, id., Xen. II. to understand, Trag. III. to intend to do, c. inf., Hdt., Soph. IV. to think of, invent, Lat. excogitare, id., Xen. V. to have in one's mind, to conceive, form a notion of, τι Plat., Xen.

εννοια.gloss: a thought in the mind, notion, conception
εννοια.def: ἔννοια, ἡ, (from ἐννοέω) 1. a thought in the mind, notion, conception, Plat. 2. a thought, intent, design, Eur., Xen.

εννομοσ.def: ἔν-νομος, ον 1. within the law, lawful, legal, Trag., etc.; ἔννομα πάσχειν to suffer lawful punishment, Thuc. 2. of persons, keeping within the law, upright, Aesch., etc.:— subject to law, NTest.

εννοσιγαιοσ.def: Ἐννοσί-γαιος, ὁ, epic for Ἐνοσί-γαιος (ἔνοσις, γαῖα) the Earth-shaker, name of Poseidon, Hom.

εννουσ.def: ἔν-νους, ουν thoughtful, intelligent, sensible, Aesch., etc.; ἔννους γίγνομαι I come to my senses, Eur.

εννυμι.def: ἕννυμι (The Root was ϜΕΣ, cf. Lat. vestio) I. to put clothes on another, c. dupl. acc., κεῖνός σε χλαῖνάν τε χιτῶνά τε ἕσσει he will clothe thee in cloak and frock, Od. II. Mid. and Pass., c. acc. rei, to clothe oneself in, to be clad in, put on, to wear, Hom.; ἀσπίδας ἑσσάμενοι, of tall shields which covered the whole person, Il.; [ξυστὰ] εἱμένα χαλκῶι shafts clad with brass, id.; and by a strong metaph., λάϊνον ἕσσο χιτῶνα thou hadst been clad in coat of stone, i. e. stoned by the people, id.:—metaph. also, φρεσὶ εἱμένοι ἀλκήν id.

εννυχευω.def: ἐννυχεύω fut. σω to sleep in or on a place, Soph.

εννυχιοσ.gloss: in the night, by night, nightly
εννυχιοσ.def: ἐννῠ́χιος, η, ον (νύξ) in the night, by night, nightly, Lat. nocturnus, Hom., Soph.:— ἐννύχιοι dwellers in the realms of Night, the dead, id.

εννυχοσ.def: ἔν-νῠχος, ον I. = ἐννῠ́χιος, Il., Aesch.:—adv. ἔννυχον or -χα, NTest. II. epith. of Hades, Soph.

ενοδιοσ.def: ἐν-όδιος, η, ον (ὁδός) in or on the way, by the way-side, Il., Aesch.:—epith. of gods, who had their statues by the way-side, Lat. triviales, as of Hecate, Soph., Eur.; Ἐνοδία, = Lat. Trivia, id.

ενοικεω.def: ἐνοικέω fut. ήσω I. to dwell in a place, c. dat., Eur.; ἐν τόπῳ Xen.; [Θυρέαν] ἔδοσαν ἐνοικεῖν gave it them to dwell in, Thuc. II. c. acc. loci, to inhabit, Hdt., Soph., etc.; οἱ ἐνοικοῦντες the inhabitants, Hdt., Thuc., etc.

ενοικησισ.def: ἐνοίκησις, εως a dwelling in a place, Thuc.

ενοικιζω.def: ἐνοικίζω fut. attic ιῶ to settle in a place:—Pass. to be settled in a place, to take up one's abode there, Hdt.; so in Mid., Thuc.

ενοικιοσ.gloss: in the house, keeping at home
ενοικιοσ.def: ἐν-οίκιος, ον (οἶκος) I. in the house, keeping at home, ἐν. ὄρνις a dunghill cock, Aesch. II. as Subst., ἐνοίκιον, ου, τό, house-rent, Dem., Anth.

ενοικοδομεω.def: ἐνοικοδομέω fut. ήσω I. to build in a place, Thuc.:—Mid., ἐν. τεῖχος to build themselves a fort there, id. II. to build up, block up, id.

ενοικοσ.def: ἔν-οικος, 1. in-dwelling: an inhabitant, Trag., Thuc., etc. 2. pass. dwelt in, Eur.

ενοικουρεω.def: ἐνοικουρέω fut. ήσω to keep house, dwell in a place, Luc.

ενοινοχοεω.def: ἐνοινοχοέω fut. ήσω to pour in wine, Hom.

ενολισθανω.def: ἐνολισθάνω or -αίνω fut. -ολισθήσω aor2 -ώλισθον to fall in, of the ground, Plut.: to slip and fall, id.

ενομιλεω.def: ἐνομιλέω (= ὁμιλέω ἐν) to be well acquainted with a thing, c. dat., Plut.

ενοπη.def: ἐνοπή, ἡ, (ἐνέπω) 1. a crying, screaming, as of birds, Il.: a war-cry, id. 2. generally, a voice, Od., Eur. 3. of things, a sound, Il., Eur.

ενοπλιοσ.def: ἐνόπλιος, ον (= ἔνοπλος) ἐνόπλιος (sc. ῥυθμός), ὁ a war-tune, march, Ar., Xen.

ενοπλοσ.def: ἔν-οπλος, ον (ὅπλον) I. in arms, armed, Soph., Eur. II. with armed men within, of the Trojan horse, id.

ενοπτρον.def: ἔν-οπτρον, ου, τό, (ὄψομαι, fut. of ὁράω) a mirror, Eur.

ενοραω.def: ἐνοράω ionic -έω fut. -όψομαι aor2 -εῖδον I. to see, remark, observe something in a person or thing, τί τινι Thuc., etc.; τι ἔν τινι Hdt., etc.; c. acc. et part. fut., ἐνεώρα τιμωρίην ἐσομένην he saw that vengeance would come, id. II. to look at or upon, Xen.

ενορκοσ.def: ἔν-ορκος, ον I. bound by oath, Lat. juratus, Soph., Thuc.: c. dat. pers., Lat. addictus, Soph. II. that whereto one is sworn, id., etc.

ενορμιζω.def: ἐνορμίζω fut. attic ιῶ to bring a ship to harbour:—Pass. to come to anchor, Theogn.

ενορμιτησ.def: ἐνορμῑ́της, ου, (from ἐνορμίζω) in harbour, Anth.

ενορνυμι.def: ἐνόρνυμι aor1 -ῶρσα epic aor2 pass. ἐνῶρτο to arouse, stir up in a person, Il.:—Pass. to arise in or among, ἐνῶρτο γέλως θεοῖσιν id.

ενορουω.def: ἐνορούω fut. ούσω to leap in or upon another, c. dat., Il.

ενορχησ.def: ἐνόρχης, ου, (= ἔνορχος, Ar.) a he-goat, Theocr.

ενορχοσ.def: ἔν-ορχος, ον (ὄρχις) uncastrated, entire, ἔνορχα μῆλα rams, Il.

ενοσ.def: ἔνος = the Lat. annus, a year, hence ἐνιαυτός, cf. ἄφ-ενος, Lat. bi-ennis, etc.
ἔνος, η, ον the day after to-morrow, Lat. perendie, only in oblique cases of fem., gen. ἔνης epic ἔννηφι (sub. ἡμέρας) Hes.; doric ἔνας Theocr.; εἰς ἕνην Ar.

ενοσ.gloss: belonging to the former of two periods, last year's
ενοσ.def: ἕνος, η, ον 1. belonging to the former of two periods, last year's, ἕναι ἀρχαί last year's magistrates, Dem.:— dat. ἕνῃ as adv., long ago, Ar. 2. ἕνη καὶ νέα (sc. ἡμέρα), the old and new day, i. e. the last day of the month, which consisted of two halves, one belonging to the old, the other to the new moon, id.

ενοσισ.def: ἔνοσις, εως a shaking, quake, Hes., Eur. (From an obsol. Root ⁎ἐνόθω to shake.)

ενοσιχθων.def: Ἐνοσί-χθων, ονος, Earth-shaker, of Poseidon, Hom.

ενουρανιοσ.def: ἐν-ουράνιος, ον in heaven, heavenly, Anth.

ενοχλεω.def: ἐνοχλέω 1. to trouble, disquiet, annoy, τινά Plat., Xen., etc.:—Pass. to be troubled or annoyed, id. 2. c. dat. to give trouble or annoyance to, id., Dem., etc. 3. absol. to be a nuisance, Ar.

ενοχοσ.def: ἔνοχος, ον (ἐνέχω) held in, i. e. liable to, subject to, c. dat., Plat.; ἔν. θανάτου (sc. ζημίᾳ) liable to the penalty of death, NTest.

ενραπτω.def: ἐνράπτω fut. ψω to sew up in, τι εἴς τι; so Mid., Hdt.: —Pass. to be sewed up in, c. dat., Eur.

ενριγοω.def: ἐνριγόω fut. ώσω to shiver or freeze in a garment, Ar.

ενσειω.def: ἐνσείω fut. σω 1. to shake in or at, Soph.; κέλαδον ἐνς. πώλοις to drive a sound into their ears, id. 2. c. acc. pers. to drive into, ἐνς. τινὰ ἀγρίαις ὁδοῖς id.

ενσημαινομαι.def: ἐνσημαίνομαι fut. -ᾰνοῦμαι Mid. to intimate, Xen.

ενσκελλω.def: ἐνσκέλλω perf. ἐνέσκληκα to be dry, withered, Anth.

ενσκευαζω.def: ἐνσκευάζω fut. άσω 1. to get ready, prepare, Ar. 2. to dress in a garment, Plut.; Ἡρακλέα ’νεσκεύασα dressed you up as Hercules, Ar.:—Mid. to dress oneself up in other clothes, id.: to arm oneself, Xen.: —Pass to be equipped, Hdt.

ενσκηπτω.def: ἐνσκήπτω fut. ψω I. to hurl, dart in or upon, τί τινι Hdt. II. intr. to fall in or on, id., Soph.

ενσκιμπτω.def: ἐνσκίμπτω poet. ἐνι-σκ- to let fall upon, οὔδει ἐνισκίμψαντε καρήατα, of horses hanging their heads in grief for their master's loss, Il.:—Pass. to stick in the ground, id. (epic form of ἐνσκήπτω)

ενσκιρροω.def: ἐνσκιρρόω fut. ώσω to harden:—Pass. to become inveterate, of diseases, Xen.

ενσοφοσ.def: ἔν-σοφος, ον wise in a thing, Anth.

ενσπονδοσ.def: ἔν-σπονδος, ον (σπονδή) I. included in a truce or treaty, Thuc.; ἔνσπ. τινί in alliance with one, Eur., Thuc.; and as Subst. an ally, id. II. under truce or safe-conduct, Eur.

ενσταζω.def: ἐνστάζω fut. ξω to drop in or into a thing, c. dat., Ar.: —Pass. to be instilled into, Od., Hdt.

ενσταλαζω.def: ἐνσταλάζω (fut. ξω, ἐνστάζω, εἴς τι, Ar.)

ενστασισ.def: ἔνστασις (ἐνίσταμαι) a beginning, plan, management, Aeschin.

ενστελλω.def: ἐνστέλλω fut. -στελῶ to dress in:—Pass., στολὴν ἐνεσταλμένος clad in a dress, Hdt.

ενστηριζω.def: ἐνστηρίζω fut. ξω to fix in:—Pass., γαίῃ ἐνεστήρικτο it stuck fast in earth, Il.

ενστρατοπεδευομαι.def: ἐνστρατοπεδεύομαι Dep. to encamp in, Hdt.;—so in Act., Thuc.

ενστρεφω.def: ἐνστρέφω fut. ψω 1. to turn inPass. to turn or move in a place, c. dat., Il. 2. c. acc. loci, σηκοὺς ἐνστρέφειν to visit them, Eur.

ενσφραγιζω.def: ἐνσφραγίζω ionic -σφρηγίζω to impress on a thing, c. dat., Anth.

εντανυω.def: ἐντανύω fut. σω poet. and ionic for ἐντείνω 1. to stretch or strain tight with cords or straps, Hom.; ἐντανύσας [τὸν θρόνον ἱμᾶσιν] to cover it with stretched straps, Hdt. 2. to stretch a cord tight, of the bow-string, Od.: also to stretch a bow tight, i. e. to string it, id.: —Mid., δυνήσεται ἐντανύσασθαι to string one's bow, id.

εντασσω.def: ἐντάσσω attic -ττω fut. ξω to place or post in:—Pass., σφενδονᾶν ἐντεταγμένος posted to use the sling, Xen.

ενταυθα.def: ἐνταῦθα (ἔνθα) I. of Place, here, there, Lat. hic, illic, Hdt., etc.; ἐνταῦθά που here-abouts, Ar. 2. like ἐνταυθοῖ, with sense of motion towards, hither, thither, Lat. huc, illuc, Il., attic 3. c. gen., ἐντ. τῆς ἠπείρου Thuc.; ἔντ. τῆς πολιτείας in that department of government, Dem. II. of Time, at the very time, then, Aesch., etc. 2. c. gen., ἐντ. ἡλικίας, Lat. ad hoc aetatis, Plat. III. of Sequence, = Lat. deinde, thereupon, then, Hdt. IV. generally, herein, Soph., Plat., etc.: in this state of things, in this position, Dem.

ενταφιαζω.def: ἐνταφιάζω (from ἐντᾰ́φιος) to prepare for burial, NTest.

ενταφιοσ.def: ἐν-τᾰ́φιος, ον (τάφος) 1. of or used in burial: hence as Subst., ἐντάφιον, ου, τό, a shroud, winding-sheet, Simon., Anth. 2. ἐντάφια, τά, offerings to the dead, obsequies, Soph.

εντεα.def: ἔντεα I. fighting gear, arms, armour, Hom. II. furniture, appliances, ἔντεα δαιτός Od.; ἔντεα νηός rigging, tackle, Hhymn.; ἔντη δίφρου the harness, Aesch.

εντεινω.def: ἐντείνω fut. -τενῶ perf. -τέτᾰκα pass. -τέτᾰμαι I. to stretch or strain tightPass., δίφρος ἱμᾶσιν ἐντέταται is hung on tight-stretched straps, Il.; γέφυραι ἐντεταμέναι a bridge with the mooring-cables made taught, Hdt.; ἐντεταμένου τοῦ σώματος being braced up, Plat. 2. to stretch a bow tight, i. e. string it for shooting (cf. ἐντανύω), Eur.; so in Mid. to string one's bow, id.:—Pass., τόξα ἐντεταμένα bows ready strung, Hdt. 3. ἐντείνειν ναῦν ποδί to keep a ship's sail taught by the sheet, Eur. 4. to tie tight, id. II. metaph. to strain, exert:—so in Mid., φωνὴν ἐντεινάμενος Aeschin.; ἐντεινάμενοι τὴν ἁρμονίαν pitching the tune high, Ar.:—and in Pass., ἐντεινόμενος, on the stretch, eager, Xen. 2. to carry on vigorously, Plut. 3. so intr. in Act. to exert oneself, be vehement, Eur. III. to stretch out at or against, πληγὴν ἐντείνειν τινί, Lat. plagam intendere, to lay a blow on him, Xen. IV. to put into verse, Plat.

εντειχιζω.def: ἐντειχίζω fut. attic ιῶ I. to build or fortify in a place, Xen. II. in Mid. to wall in, i. e. blockade, Thuc.

εντεκνοομαι.def: ἐντεκνόομαι Dep. to beget children in, Plut. (from ἔντεκνος)

εντελευταω.def: ἐντελευτάω fut. ήσω to end one's life in a place, Thuc.

εντελησ.def: ἐν-τελής, ές (τέλος) 1. complete, full, Ar., Thuc. 2. of victims, perfect, unblemished, Soph. 3. of soldiers and their equipments, in good condition, effective, Thuc. 4. of men, full-grown, Aesch.

εντελλω.def: ἐντέλλω mostly in Mid., fut. -τελοῦμαι (mostly in Mid., fut. -τελοῦμαι) to enjoin, command, τί τινι Hdt., etc.; ἐντέλλεσθαι ἀπὸ γλώσσης to command by word of mouth, id.:—Pass., τὰ ἐντεταλμένα commands, id., Xen.

εντεμνω.def: ἐντέμνω ionic -τάμνω fut. -τεμῶ I. to cut in, engrave upon, ἐν τοῖσι λίθοισι γράμματα Hdt. II. to cut up, 1. to cut up the victim, sacrifice, Thuc. 2. to cut in, shred in, as herbs in a medical mixture, ἄκος ἐντ. Aesch. 3. to cut in two, Luc.

εντερον.def: ἔντερον, ου, τό, (ἐντός) an intestine, piece of gut, ἔντερον οἰός a string of sheep's gut, Od.:—mostly in pl. ἔντερα, the guts, bowels, Il., attic

εντερονεια.def: ἐντερόνεια, ἡ, (from ἔντερον) the timber of a ship, belly-timber, Ar.

εντεσιεργοσ.def: ἐντεσι-εργός, όν (ἔργον) working in harness, ἡμίονοι ἐντ. draught- mules, Il.

εντευθεν.def: ἐντεῦθεν (ἔνθεν) I. of Place, hence or thence, Lat. hinc or illinc, Od., etc. II. of Time, henceforth, thenceforth, thereupon, Hdt., etc.; τοὐντεῦθεν Eur.; τἀντεῦθεν what remains, Aesch. III. Causal, from that source, Thuc.

εντευκτικοσ.def: ἐντευκτικός, ή, όν affable, Plut. (from ἔντευξις)

εντευξισ.gloss: a lighting upon, meeting with, converse, intercourse
εντευξισ.def: ἔντευξις, εως (ἐντυγχάνω) 1. a lighting upon, meeting with, converse, intercourse, τινος with a person, Aeschin. 2. a petition, Plut.: intercession for a person, NTest.

εντευτλανοομαι.def: ἐντευτλανόομαι Pass. to be stewed in beet (τεῦτλον), Ar.

εντεχνοσ.gloss: within the province of art, artificial, artistic
εντεχνοσ.def: ἔν-τεχνος, ον (τέχνη) within the province of art, artificial, artistic, Plat.

εντηκω.def: ἐντήκω fut. ξω I. to pour in while molten, μόλιβδον Plut. II. Pass., with perf. act. ἐντέτηκα, 1. of feelings, to sink deep in, Soph. 2. of persons, to be absorbed by a thing, id.

εντιθημι.def: ἐντίθημι fut. -θήσω poet. aor1 inf. ἐνθέμεν 1. to put in or into a ship, Od., attic; so in Mid., Od.:—then, generally, to put in or into, Hes., Hdt., etc. 2. metaph. to put into a person, inspire, Theogn., Xen.;— Mid., χόλον ἔνθεο θυμῷ thou didst store up wrath in thy heart, Il.; πατέρας ἔνθεο τιμῇ hold our fathers in honour, id. 3. to put in the mouth, τί τινι Ar.; and in Mid., ἐνθοῦ, put in, i. e. eat, id.

εντικτω.def: ἐντίκτω fut. -τέξομαι I. to bear or produce in a place, c. dat., Eur.; ᾠὰ ἐντ. ἐς τὴν ἰλύν to drop eggs into the mud, Hdt. 2. to create or cause in a person, τί τινι Eur. II. perf. part. ἐντετοκώς intr., inborn, innate, Ar.

εντιλαω.def: ἐντιλάω fut. ήσω Lat. incacare, to squirt upon, τί τινι Ar.

εντιμαω.def: ἐντιμάω fut. ήσω to value in or among, Dem.

εντιμοσ.def: ἔν-τῑμος, ον (τιμή) 1. of persons, in honour, honoured, prized, Soph., etc.:—c. dat. rei, honoured with or in a thing, Eur.:— οἱ ἔντιμοι men in office, men of rank, Xen. 2. of things, honoured, held in honour, Soph. 3. adv., ἐντίμως ἔχειν to be in honour, Xen.

εντμημα.def: ἔντμημα, ατος, τό, (ἐντέμνω) an incision, notch, Xen.

εντολη.def: ἐντολή, ἡ, (ἐντέλλω) an injunction, order, command, behest, Hdt., etc.

εντομοσ.def: ἔντομος, ον (ἐντέμνω) cut in pieces, cut up: neut. pl., ἔντομα victims, Hdt.

εντονοσ.def: ἔντονος, ον (ἐντείνω) of persons, well-strung, sinewy: metaph. intense, earnest, eager, vehement, Hdt., attic: —adv. ἐντόνως, eagerly, violently, Thuc., Xen.

εντοποσ.def: ἔν-τοπος, ον in or of a place, Soph.

εντορευω.def: ἐντορεύω fut. σω to carve in relief on a thing, Plut.

εντοσ.def: ἐντός (ἐν) within, inside, Lat. intus, opp. to ἐκτός: I. as prep. with gen., τείχεος ἐντός Il.; ἐντὸς Ὀλύμπου Hes., etc.; ἐντὸς ἐμαυτοῦ in my senses, Hdt.; so absol., ἐντὸς ὤν Dem.:—also with Verbs of motion, τείχεος ἐντὸς ἰέναι Il. 2. within, i. e. on this side, Lat. citra, ἐντὸς τοῦ Ἄλυος ποταμοῦ Hdt., etc. 3. of Time, within, ἐντὸς εἴκοσιν ἡμερῶν Thuc.; ἐντὸς ἑσπέρας short of, i. e. before, evening, Xen. II. absol. within, ἐντὸς ἐέργειν Hom.; ἐντὸς ἔχειν Thuc.; τὰ ἐντός the inner parts, inwards, id.

εντοσθε.def: ἔντοσθε from within, Od.: —also = ἐντός, within, absol. or c. gen., Il.

εντραγειν.gloss: to eat greedily, to gobble up
εντραγειν.def: ἐντραγεῖν fut. ξομαι aor2 ἐνέτρᾰγον to eat greedily, to gobble up, Ar.:—c. gen. to eat greedily of, Luc.

εντραγωδεω.def: ἐντραγῳδέω fut. ήσω to strut among, τισί Luc.

εντρεπω.def: ἐντρέπω fut. -τρέψω I. to turn about τὰ νῶτα Hdt.: to alter, Luc. II. Mid. or Pass., aor2 ἐνετράπην [ᾰ], to turn about, linger, hesitate, Soph. 2. c. gen. pers. to turn towards, give heed to, pay regard to, to respect or reverence, Hom., Trag. 3. c. inf. to take care that, Theogn. 4. absol. to feel shame or fear, NTest.

εντρεφω.def: ἐντρέφω fut. -θρέψω to bring up in the house, Eur.:— so in Mid., Hes.:—Pass. to be reared in a place, c. dat., Eur.

εντρεχω.def: ἐντρέχω fut. -δρᾰμοῦμαι I. to run in, εἰ ἐντρέχοι ἀγλαὰ γυῖα, if his limbs moved freely in [the armour], Il. II. to slip in, enter, Anth.

εντριβησ.def: ἐντρῐβής, ές (from ἐντρίβω) metaph. from the touchstone, proved by rubbing, versed in a thing, c. dat., Soph.

εντριβω.def: ἐντρίβω fut. ψω I. to rub in or into a thing, c. dat., Luc. 2. metaph., ἐντρ. κόνδυλόν τινι to give him a drubbing, Plut.; so in Mid., Luc. II. c. acc. pers. to rub one with cosmetics, Xen.:—Pass. to have cosmetics rubbed in, to be anointed, painted, id. III. to wear away by rubbing, Ar.

εντριμμα.def: ἔντριμμα, ατος, τό, (from ἐντρῑ́βω) a cosmetic, Plut.

εντριτωνιζω.def: ἐντριτωνίζω (ἐν, τρίτος) to third with water, i. e. to mix three parts of water with two of wine, —with a pun on ἡ Τριτογενής, Ar.

εντριψισ.def: ἔντριψις, εως (ἐντρίβω) a rubbing in, Xen.

εντροπαλιζομαι.def: ἐντροπαλίζομαι Pass., Frequent. of ἐντρέπω to keep turning round, of men retreating, Il.

εντροπη.def: ἐντροπή, ἡ, (ἐντρέπω) a turning towards, ἐντροπήν τινος ἔχειν respect or reverence for one, Soph.: shame, reproach, NTest.

εντροπια.def: ἐντροπία, ἡ, (from ἐντροπή) a trick, dodge, Hhymn.

εντροφοσ.def: ἔντροφος, ον (ἐντρέφω) 1. living in or acquainted with a thing, c. dat., Soph. 2. as Subst., nursling, Anth.

εντρυφαω.def: ἐντρυφάω fut. ήσω I. to revel in a thing, c. dat., Menand.: —absol. to be luxurious, Xen. II. to mock at, τινί Eur.

εντυγχανω.gloss: to light upon, fall in with, meet with
εντυγχανω.def: ἐντυγχάνω fut. -τεύξομαι aor2 ἐνέτῠχον perf. ἐντετύχηκα aor1 pass. part. ἐντευχθείς I. in act. sense:— to light upon, fall in with, meet with a person or thing, c. dat., Hdt., etc.:—absol., ὁ ἐντυχών the first who meets us, any chance person, Thuc.; of thunder, to fall upon, c. dat., Xen.; so of misfortunes, Aesch. 2. rarely, like τυγχάνω c. gen., λελυμένης τῆς γεφύρης ἐντυχόντες having found the bridge broken up, Hdt.; ἐντυχὼν Ἀσκληπιδῶν having fallen in with them, Soph. II. to converse with, talk to, τινί Plat. 2. to intercede with, intreat, τινί NTest., Plut.:—c. inf. to intreat one to do, id. III. of books, to meet with, Plat.: hence, to read, Luc.

εντυλισσω.def: ἐντυλίσσω fut. ξω to wrap up, Ar.

εντυνω.gloss: to equip, deck out, get ready
εντυνω.def: ἐντύνω imperf. ἔντῡνον fut. ἐντῠνῶ aor1 ἔντῡνα imperf. ἔντυον to equip, deck out, get ready, Hom.; δέπας δ’ ἔντυνον (aor1 imperat.) prepare the cup, i. e. mix the wine, Il.; εὖ ἐντύνασαν ἓ αὐτήν having decked herself well out, id.:—Mid., ὄφρα τάχιστα ἐντύνεαι (epic for ἐντύνῃ) may'st get thee ready, Od.:—Mid., c. acc., to prepare for oneself, ἐντύνεσθαι δαῖτα, δεῖπνον Hom.

εντυπασ.def: ἐντυπάς (τύπος) adv., ἐντυπὰς ἐν χλαίνῃ κεκαλυμμένος (of Priam in his grief), wrapt up in his mantle so closely as to shew his limbs, Il.

εντυποω.def: ἐντυπόω fut. ώσω to cut in intaglio, Plut.

εντυφω.def: ἐντύφω fut. -θύψω to smoke as one does wasps, Ar.

ενυαλιοσ.def: Ἐνῡᾰ́λιος, ὁ, I. the Warlike, name of Ares (Mars), Il., Soph., etc. 2. as appellat. war, battle, Eur. II. as adj. warlike, furious, Theocr.

ενυβριζω.def: ἐνυβρίζω fut. attic ιῶ to insult or mock one in a thing, c. dat., Soph.; τινὰ ἐν κακοῖς Eur.

ενυδροβιοσ.def: ἐνυδρό-βῐος, ον living in the water, Anth.

ενυδροσ.gloss: with water in it, holding water
ενυδροσ.def: ἔν-υδρος, ον (ὕδωρ) 1. with water in it, holding water, ἔν. τεῦχος, i. e. a bath, Aesch.; of countries, well watered, Hdt.; ἔν. φρούριον provided with water, Xen. 2. of water, watery, Eur. 3. living in or by water, of Nymphs, Soph.; of plants, Ar.

ενυπνιον.def: ἐν-ύπνιον, ου, τό, (ὕπνος) 1. a thing seen in sleep, ἐνύπνιον ἦλθεν ὄνειρος a dream or vision in sleep came to me, Od.:—hence as adv., ἐνύπνιον ἑστιᾶσθαι "to feast with the Barmecide," Ar. 2. simply a dream, Hdt., attic

ενυπνιοσ.def: ἐν-ύπνιος, ον (ὕπνος) in dreams appearing, Aesch.

ενυφαινω.gloss: to weave in as a pattern
ενυφαινω.def: ἐνυφαίνω fut. ᾰνῶ to weave in as a pattern:—Pass. to be inwoven, Hdt.

ενυω.def: Ἐνυώ Enyo, goddess of war, answering to the Roman Bellona, Il., Aesch.

ενωθεω.def: ἐνωθέω aor1 -έωσα to thrust in or upon, Plut., Luc.

ενωμοταρχησ.def: ἐνωμοτάρχης leader of an ἐνωμοτία, Thuc., Xen.

ενωμοτια.gloss: a band of sworn soldiers, a company in the Spartan army
ενωμοτια.def: ἐνωμοτία a band of sworn soldiers, a company in the Spartan army, the λόχος contained 4 πεντηκοστύες, each πεντηκοστύς 4 ἐνωμοτίαι, and each ἐνωμοτία 32 men, Thuc., Xen. (from ἐνώμοτος)

ενωμοτοσ.def: ἐν-ώμοτος, ον (ὄμνυμι) I. bound by oath, Soph.:—adv. -τως, on oath, Plut. II. a conspirator, id.

ενωπαδιωσ.gloss: in one's face, to one's face
ενωπαδιωσ.def: ἐνωπαδίως in one's face, to one's face, Od. (from ἐνωπή)

ενωπη.def: ἐν-ωπή, ἡ, (ὤψ) the face, countenance, dat. ἐνωπῇ as adv., before the face, openly, Il.

ενωπια.gloss: the inner wall fronting those who enter
ενωπια.def: ἐνώπια, τά, the inner wall fronting those who enter a building or the side-walls of the entrance, Hom. (from ἐνώπιος)

ενωπιοσ.def: ἐν-ώπιος, ον (ὤψ) I. face to face, Theocr. II. neut. ἐνώπιον, prep. with gen., like Lat. coram, NTest.

ενωτιζομαι.def: ἐνωτίζομαι (οὖς) Dep. to hearken to a thing, τι NTest.

εξ.def: ἕξ six, Hom., etc.—In composition, before δ κ π, it becomes ἑκ, as ἕκδραχμος, ἑκκαίδεκα, ἕκπλεθρος; or has α inserted, as ἑξάκλινος, etc.
ἐξ Lat. ex, the form of the prep. ἐκ, before a vowel and before some consonants, as ῥ ς.

εξαγγελια.def: ἐξαγγελία, ἡ, information sent out to the enemy, Xen.

εξαγγελλω.def: ἐξαγγέλλω fut. ελῶ to send out tidings, report, of traitors and the like, Il., attic:—Mid. to cause to be proclaimed, Hdt., Soph.; c. inf. to promise to do, Eur.: —Pass. to be reported, Hdt.; impers., ἐξαγγέλλεται it is reported, id.

εξαγγελοσ.gloss: a messenger who brings out news
εξαγγελοσ.def: ἐξ-άγγελος, ὁ, ἡ, I. a messenger who brings out news from within, an informer, Thuc., etc. II. on the Greek stage, ἄγγελοι told news from a distance, ἐξάγγελοι what was a-doing behind the scenes, as in Soph.

εξαγγελτοσ.def: ἐξάγγελτος, ον (from ἐξάγγελος) told of, denounced, Thuc.

εξαγιζω.def: ἐξαγίζω Pass., aor1 part. ἐξαγισθείς to drive out as accursed:—Pass., aor1 part. ἐξαγισθείς, Aesch.

εξαγινεω.def: ἐξαγινέω ionic for ἐξάγω to lead forth, Hdt.

εξαγιστοσ.def: ἐξάγιστος, ον (ἐξαγίζω) I. devoted to evil, accursed, abominable, Dem., Aeschin. II. ἐξάγιστα holy things, matters of religion, Soph.

εξαγνυμι.gloss: to break and tear away, to rend
εξαγνυμι.def: ἐξάγνυμι fut. -άξω to break and tear away, to rend, Il.

εξαγοραζω.def: ἐξαγοράζω fut. σω I. to buy up, Plut. II. to redeem, NTest.; so in Mid., id.

εξαγορευτικοσ.def: ἐξᾰγορευτικός, ή, όν fit to explain, τινος Luc. (from ἐξᾰγορεύω)

εξαγορευω.gloss: to tell out, make known, declare
εξαγορευω.def: ἐξαγορεύω (the aor. is supplied by ἐξεῖπον, the fut. and perf. by ἐξερῶ, ἐξείρηκα) to tell out, make known, declare, Od.: to betray a secret or mystery, Hdt.

εξαγριαινω.def: ἐξαγριαίνω fut. ᾰνῶ to make savage, Plat.:—Pass. to be or become savage, id.

εξαγριοω.def: ἐξαγριόω fut. ώσω I. to make wild or waste:—Pass. to be or be made so, Aeschin. II. like ἐξ-αγριαίνω to make savage, exasperate, Hdt., Eur.

εξαγω.def: ἐξάγω fut. ξω aor2 -ήγᾰγον to lead out: I. of persons, to lead or carry out from a place, Hom., etc.: to bring forth into the world, Il.: to lead out to execution, Hdt. b. to march out (sub. στρατόν), Xen.: generally, to go out, id. 2. to eject a claimant from property, Dem., etc. II. of merchandise, to carry out, export, Ar., etc.:—Pass., τὰ ἐξαγόμενα exports, Xen. 2. to draw off water, id. 3. of building, to carry further out, Thuc. III. to call forth, excite, δάκρυ Eur.:—Mid., γέλωτα ἐξάγεσθαι Xen. IV. to lead on, carry away, excite, τινά Eur., Thuc.; and in bad sense, to lead on, tempt, id.:—Pass. to be led on, c. inf., Xen.

εξαγωγη.def: ἐξᾰγωγή, ἡ, (from ἐξάγω) 1. a leading out of soldiers, Xen. 2. a drawing out of a ship to sea, Hdt. 3. a carrying out, exportation, id., attic

εξαγωνιζομαι.def: ἐξαγωνίζομαι fut. attic ιοῦμαι Dep. to struggle hard, Eur.

εξαγωνιοσ.def: ἐξ-αγώνιος, ον beside the mark, irrelevant, Luc.

εξαδαρχοσ.gloss: leader of a body of six
εξαδαρχοσ.def: ἑξάδ-αρχος, ον (ἑξάς) leader of a body of six, Xen.

εξαδω.gloss: to sing out, sing one's last song
εξαδω.def: ἐξᾴδω fut. -ᾴσομαι I. to sing out, sing one's last song, of the swan, Plat. II. trans. to sing of, laud, Eur.

εξαειρω.gloss: to lift up, lift off the earth
εξαειρω.def: ἐξαείρω I. to lift up, lift off the earth, Hom., Hdt.; ἐξάραντες having bade me rise (from suppliant posture), Soph. 2. to raise in dignity, exalt, Hdt., Aeschin. 3. to raise, arouse, stir up, Theogn., Soph.; ἐξ. σε θανεῖν excites thy wish to die, Eur. II. Mid., 3rd sg. aor1 ἐξήρατο, to carry off for oneself, earn, win, gain, Od. 2. to take on oneself, Soph. III. Pass. to be raised, Hdt.: to rise up, rise, Eur.:— to be excited, agitated, Soph.

εξαεροω.def: ἐξαερόω fut. ώσω (ἀήρ) to make into air, volatilise, Luc.

εξαετησ.def: ἑξα-ετής, ές (ἔτος) I. six years old: fem. ἑξαέτις, Theocr. II. of six years, χρόνος Plut.:—adv., ἑξάετες, for six years, Od.

εξαθροιζομαι.def: ἐξαθροίζομαι Mid. to seek out and collect, Eur.

εξαθυμεω.def: ἐξαθυμέω fut. ήσω to be quite disheartened, Plut.

εξαιμασσω.def: ἐξαιμάσσω attic -ττω fut. ξω to make quite bloody, Xen.

εξαινυμαι.def: ἐξαίνυμαι epic Dep. to carry off, Od.; c. dupl. acc., ἐξαίνυτο θυμὸν ἀμφοτέρω took away life from both, Il.

εξαιρεσισ.def: ἐξαίρεσις, εως a taking out, Hdt.:— a way of taking out, id. (from ἐξαιρέω)

εξαιρετεοσ.def: ἐξαιρετέος, η, ον (verb. adj.) (from ἐξαιρέω) I. to be taken out or removed, Xen. II. ἐξαιρετέον, one must take out: one must pick out, select, id.

εξαιρετοσ.gloss: that can be taken out, removable
εξαιρετοσ.def: ἐξαιρετός, ή, όν (from ἐξαιρέω) I. that can be taken out, removable, Hdt. II. ἐξαίρετος, ον taken out, picked out, chosen, Lat. eximius, Hom., etc. 2. excepted, Eur., Thuc., etc.: special, remarkable, Dem.

εξαιρεω.def: ἐξαιρέω fut. ήσω aor2 ἐξεῖλον epic ἔξελον inf. ἐξελεῖν Pass., perf. ἐξῄρημαι ionic -αραίρημαι I. to take out of a thing, τί τινος Hom., etc.; ἔκ τινος Hdt., etc.:—simply to take out, νηδύν id.:—Mid. to take out for oneself, Il.; ἐξ. τὰ φορτία to discharge their cargoes, Hdt. II. to take from among others, to pick out, choose, Hom., etc.:—Mid. to choose for oneself, carry off as booty, id.:—Pass. to be given as a special honour, τινι to one, Thuc.; ἐξαραιρημένος Ποσειδέωνι dedicated to him, Hdt. 2. to take out of a number, to except, id., attic III. to expel people from their seats, Hdt., Thuc. 2. to take out, remove, Hdt., attic 3. in Mid. to bereave a person of life, c. dupl. acc., μιν ἐξείλετο θυμόν Il., attic; or c. gen. pers., μευ φρένας ἐξέλετο Il.; rarely c. dat. pers., id.:—Mid. to take away from one, Soph.:—Pass., ἐξαιρεθέντες τὸν Δημοκήδεα having had him taken out of their hands, Hdt. IV. in Mid. to set free, deliver, Aesch., Dem. V. to make away with, annul, Soph.: to demolish a city, Hdt., etc. 2. to bring to an end, accomplish, Eur.

εξαισιοσ.def: ἐξ-αίσιος, ον 1. beyond what is ordained or fated: hence, 1. lawless, Od. 2. extraordinary, violent, Hdt., Xen.; ἐξ. φυγή headlong flight, id.

εξαισσω.gloss: to rush forth, start out from
εξαισσω.def: ἐξαίσσω attic -ᾴσσω fut. ξω to rush forth, start out from, c. gen., Il.; ἐκ τοῦ νεώ Ar.:—so in Pass., Il.

εξαιστοω.def: ἐξαιστόω fut. ώσω to utterly destroy, Aesch.

εξαιτεω.def: ἐξαιτέω fut. ήσω I. to demand or ask for from another, c. dupl. acc., τήνδε μ’ ἐξαιτεῖ χάριν Soph.; ἐξ. τινα πατρός to ask her in marriage from.., id.:— ἐξ. τινα to demand the surrender of a person, Hdt., Dem.;— σμικρὸν ἐξ. to beg for little, Soph. II. Mid. to ask for oneself, demand, Hdt., Soph., etc. 2. in Mid. also, = παραιτοῦμαι, to beg off, gain his pardon or release, Lat. exorare, Aesch., Xen.; c. inf. to beg that one may obtain, Eur.:—c. acc. rei, to avert by begging, Lat. deprecari, id.

εξαιτησισ.def: ἐξαίτησις, εως (from ἐξαιτέω) I. a demanding one for punishment, Dem. II. intercession, id.

εξαιτοσ.gloss: much asked for, much desired, choice, excellent
εξαιτοσ.def: ἔξ-αιτος, ον (αἰτέω) much asked for, much desired, choice, excellent, Hom.

εξαιφνησ.def: ἐξαίφνης (ἄφνω) adv. on a sudden, Il., attic; ἐξ. ἀποθανόντος, the moment he is dead, Plat.

εξακεομαι.gloss: to heal completely, heal the wound, make amends
εξακεομαι.def: ἐξακέομαι fut. έσομαι I. Dep. to heal completely, heal the wound, make amends, Il. II. c. acc. to appease, Hom.; to make up for, Xen. 2. to mend clothes, Plat.

εξακεσισ.def: ἐξᾰ́κεσις, εως (from ἐξᾰκέομαι) a thorough cure, Ar.

εξακισ.def: ἑξάκις (ἕξ) six times, Lat. sexies, Plat., etc.: poet. ἑξάκι, Anth.

εξακισχιλιοι.def: ἑξακισχίλιοι six thousand, Hdt., Thuc., etc.

εξακοντιζω.def: ἐξακοντίζω fut. attic ιῶ 1. to dart or hurl forth, Xen.; φάσγανον πρὸς ἧπαρ ἐξ. to strike it home, Eur. 2. metaph., ἐξ. κῶλον τῆς γῆς i. e. to flee precipitately, id.; τοὺς πόνους ἐξ. to proclaim loudly, id.

εξακουω.def: ἐξακούω fut. -ακούσομαι to hear a sound, esp. from a distance, Aesch., Soph.; c. gen. pers., Xen.; rei, Plut.

εξακριβοω.def: ἐξακριβόω fut. ώσω to make exact, ἐξ. λόγον to make a distinct or precise statement, Soph.

εξακριζω.def: ἐξακρίζω fut. σω to reach the top of, ἐξ. αἰθέρα to skim the upper air, Eur.

εξακτεοσ.def: ἐξακτέος (Verbal Adj. of ἐξάγω) (ἐξάγω I. 1. b) one must march out, Xen.

εξαλαοω.def: ἐξαλαόω fut. ώσω I. to blind utterly, Od. II. to put an eye quite out, id.

εξαλαπαζω.def: ἐξαλαπάζω fut. ξω to sack a city, Il., etc.:—also, to empty a city of its inhabitants, clear it out, so as to plant new settlers in it, μίαν πόλιν ἐξαλαπάξας Od.: generally, to destroy utterly, Il.

εξαλειπτρον.def: ἐξάλειπτρον, ου, τό, an unguent-box, Ar. (from ἐξᾰλείφω)

εξαλειφω.def: ἐξαλείφω fut. ψω Pass. perf. ἐξ-ήλιμμαι attic -αλήλιμμαι I. to plaster or wash over, Hdt., Thuc. II. to wipe out, obliterate, Eur.:— ἐξ. τινά to strike his name off the roll, Ar., etc. 2. metaph., like Lat. delere, to wipe out, destroy utterly, Aesch., Eur.:—Mid., ἐξαλείψασθαι φρενός to blot it out of one's mind, id.

εξαλεομαι.def: ἐξαλέομαι Dep. to beware of, avoid, escape, Il.; epic aor1 inf. ἐξαλέασθαι, Hes., Ar., Soph.

εξαλινδω.def: ἐξαλίνδω only in aor1 part. ἐξαλίσας perf. ἐξήλῑκα to roll out or thoroughly, ἄπαγε τὸν ἵππον ἐξαλίσας take him away when you have given him a good roll on the ἀλινδήθρα, Ar.; ἐξήλικας ἐμέ γ’ ἐκ τῶν ἐμῶν you have rolled me out of house and home, id.

εξαλλαγη.def: ἐξαλλᾰγή, ἡ, a complete change, alteration, Plat. (from ἐξαλλάσσω)

εξαλλασσω.def: ἐξαλλάσσω attic -ττω fut. ξω I. to change utterly or completely, Eur.:—Mid., μηδὲν ἐξαλλάσσεται he sees no change take place, Soph. 2. to withdraw from a place, c. acc., Eur. II. ἐξαλλάσσειν τί τινος to remove from, c. gen., Thuc. 2. intr. to change, turn another way, move back and forward, Eur.; ποίαν ἐξαλλάξω; which other way shall I take? id.; ἐξαλλάσσουσα χάρις unusual grace, id.

εξαλλομαι.def: ἐξάλλομαι fut. -ᾰλοῦμαι epic aor2 part. ἐξάλμενος I. Dep.:— to leap out of or forth from a place, c. gen., Il.; προμάχων ἐξάλμενος springing out from the front rank, id.; ἐξάλατο ναός (doric for ἐξήλατο νηός) Theocr.:—absol. to jump off, hop off, Ar.; ἵν’ ἐξήλλου; to what point didst thou leap forth, i. e. to what misery hast thou come? Soph.; of wheels, to start from the axle, Xen. II. to leap up. id.: of horses, to rear, id.

εξαλυσκω.def: ἐξαλύσκω fut. ύξω aor1 ἐξήλυξα like ἐξαλέομαι to flee from, c. acc., Eur.; absol. to escape, Aesch., Eur.

εξαμαρτανω.gloss: to err from the mark, fail
εξαμαρτανω.def: ἐξαμαρτάνω fut. ήσομαι aor2 -ήμαρτον I. to err from the mark, fail, Xen.: to miss one's aim, Soph. 2. to err, do wrong, sin, Hdt., attic; c. acc. cogn., ἐξ. τι to commit a fault, Hdt., Soph., etc. II. in Pass. to be mismanaged, Plat.

εξαμαρτια.def: ἐξᾰμαρτία, ἡ, (from ἐξᾰμαρτάνω) an error, transgression, Soph.

εξαμαω.def: ἐξαμάω fut. ήσω to mow or reap out, to finish mowing or reaping, Trag.:—metaph. to cut out, in Mid., Eur.:—Pass., γένους ῥίζαν ἐξημημένος (part. perf.) having the race cut off root and branch, Soph.

εξαμβλοω.def: ἐξαμβλόω fut. ώσω 1. to make to miscarry, Eur. 2. to make abortive, Ar.

εξαμειβω.def: ἐξαμείβω fut. ψω I. to exchange, alter, ἐξαμείψασαι τρόμον having put away fear from one, Eur.:—Mid. to take the place of, c. gen., id.; so intr. in Act., c. dat., φόνῳ φόνος ἐξαμείβων murder following after murder, id. II. of Place, to change one for another, pass over, c. acc., Aesch., Eur.: absol. to withdraw, depart, id. III. in Mid. also to requite, repay, Aesch.

εξαμελγω.def: ἐξαμέλγω fut. ξω I. to milk out, suck out, Aesch. II. to press out, Eur.

εξαμελεω.def: ἐξαμελέω to be utterly careless of a thing, c. gen., Hdt.

εξαμετροσ.def: ἑξά-μετρος, ον of six metres, hexameter, Hdt., etc.

εξαμηνοσ.def: ἑξά-μηνος, ον of, lasting six months: ἑξάμ. (sc. χρόνος), a half-year, Xen.; ἡ ἑξάμ. (sc. ὥρη), Hdt.

εξαμηχανεω.gloss: to get out of a difficulty
εξαμηχανεω.def: ἐξαμηχανέω fut. ήσω to get out of a difficulty, c. gen., Eur.

εξαμιλλαομαι.def: ἐξαμιλλάομαι fut. ήσομαι aor1 part. ἐξαμιλλησάμενος and -ηθείς I. Dep.:— to struggle vehemently, c. acc. cogn., τὰς τεθρίππους ἁμίλλας ἐξαμιλληθείς having contested the chariot-race, Eur. II. to drive out of a place, c. gen., id.: to drive out of his wits, id. III. aor1 in pass. sense, to be forced out, of the Cyclops' eye, id.

εξαμυνομαι.gloss: to ward off from oneself, drive away
εξαμυνομαι.def: ἐξαμύνομαι fut. -αμῠνοῦμαι Mid. to ward off from oneself, drive away, Aesch., Eur.

εξαναβρυω.def: ἐξαναβρύω to gush or cause to gush forth, Aesch.

εξαναγιγνωσκω.def: ἐξαναγιγνώσκω fut. -γνώσομαι to read through, Plut.

εξαναγκαζω.def: ἐξαναγκάζω fut. άσω I. to force or compel utterly, τινὰ ποιεῖν τι Soph., Eur., etc.; c. acc. only, Soph. II. to drive away, Xen.

εξαναγω.def: ἐξανάγω fut. άξω to bring out of or up from, c.gen., Eur.:—Pass. to put out to sea, set sail, Hdt., etc.

εξαναδυομαι.gloss: to rise out of, emerge from
εξαναδυομαι.def: ἐξαναδύομαι (Dep. with aor2 act. ἐξανέδυν) aor2 act. ἐξανέδυν 1. Dep., to rise out of, emerge from water, c. gen., Od. 2. to escape from, c. gen., Theogn., Plut.

εξαναζεω.def: ἐξαναζέω fut. -ζέσω to boil up with, c. acc. cogn., ἐξαναζέσει χόλον will let fury boil forth, Aesch.

εξαναιρεω.def: ἐξαναιρέω to take out of, c. gen., Hhymn.; Mid., Eur.

εξανακρουομαι.def: ἐξανακρούομαι fut. σομαι Mid. to retreat out of a place by backing water, Hdt.

εξαναλισκω.def: ἐξαναλίσκω fut. -ανᾱλώσω perf. pass. -ανήλωμαι 1. to spend entirely, Dem.:— to exhaust, Plut. 2. to destroy utterly, Aesch.:—Pass., Dem.

εξαναλυω.def: ἐξαναλύω fut. ύσω to set quite free from, c.gen., Il.

εξαναπτω.def: ἐξανάπτω fut. ψω I. to hang from or by a thing, c. gen., Eur.:—Mid. to attach to oneself, τι id. II. to rekindle, Anth.

εξαναρπαζω.def: ἐξαναρπάζω fut. σω or ξω to snatch away, Eur.

εξανασπαω.def: ἐξανασπάω fut. άσω to tear away from, Hdt., Eur.: to tear up from, χθονός id.

εξαναστασισ.def: ἐξανάστᾰσις, εως (ἐξανίσταμαι) a rising up from, resurrection from the dead, NTest.

εξαναστεφω.def: ἐξαναστέφω fut. ψω to crown with wreaths, Eur.

εξαναστρεφω.def: ἐξαναστρέφω fut. ψω to hurl headlong from a place, c. gen., Aesch.

εξανατελλω.def: ἐξανατέλλω fut. -τελῶ intr. to spring up from a place, c. gen., Mosch.

εξαναφερω.def: ἐξαναφέρω fut. -ανοίσω I. to bear up out of the water, Plut. II. intr. to recover from an illness, id.

εξαναχωρεω.gloss: to go out of the way, withdraw, retreat
εξαναχωρεω.def: ἐξαναχωρέω fut. ήσω I. to go out of the way, withdraw, retreat, Hdt. II. c. acc. to evade, Thuc.

εξανδραποδιζω.def: ἐξανδραποδίζω Mid. ἐξανδραποδίζομαι fut. attic -ιοῦμαι I. to reduce to utter slavery, Hdt., Xen., etc. II. also as Pass., Hdt., Dem.

εξανδραποδισισ.def: ἐξανδρᾰπόδισις, εως (from ἐξανδρᾰποδίζω) a selling for slaves, Hdt.

εξανδροομαι.def: ἐξανδρόομαι perf. -ήνδρωμαι I. Pass. to come to man's years, Hdt., Eur. II. ὀδόντων ὄφεος ἐξηνδρωμένος having grown to men from serpent's teeth, id.

εξανειμι.def: ἐξάνειμι I. to rise from the horizon, of stars, Theocr. II. to come back from, ἄγρης Hhymn.

εξανεμοω.gloss: to blow out with wind, inflate
εξανεμοω.def: ἐξανεμόω fut. ώσω to blow out with wind, inflate, Eur.: —metaph., ἐξηνεμώθην I was puffed up, id.

εξανερχομαι.def: ἐξανέρχομαι to come forth from, c. gen., Eur.

εξανευρισκω.def: ἐξανευρίσκω to find out, invent, Soph.

εξανεχω.def: ἐξανέχω fut. -έξω I. to hold up from: but mostly intr. to jut out from, c. gen., Theocr. II. Mid., imperf. and aor2 with double augm. ἐξηνειχόμην, ἐξηνεσχόμην, to bear up against, endure, with part., ἐξανασχοίμην κλύων Soph.; ταῦτα παῖδας ἐξανέξεται πάσχοντας Eur.; ταῦτα δόξαντ’ ἐξηνέσχετο endured that these things should be decreed, id.

εξανθεω.def: ἐξανθέω fut. ήσω 1. to put out flowers, Xen. 2. metaph. to burst forth, like an efflorescence, bloom forth, Aesch., Eur.:—of ulcers, to break out, Thuc., Luc.

εξανιημι.def: ἐξανίημι fut. -ανήσω or -ήσομαι 1. to send forth, let loose, Il., Soph.:—c. gen. to send forth from, Eur. 2. to let go, id. 3. to slacken, undo, id.:—and intr. to slacken, relax, Soph.; c. gen., ὀργῆς ἐξανείς Eur.

εξανιστημι.gloss: to raise up: to make one rise
εξανιστημι.def: ἐξανίστημι I. Causal in pres., imperf., fut. and aor 1, 1. to raise up: to make one rise from his seat, bid one rise from suppliant posture, Eur.; ἐξ. τὴν ἐνέδραν to order the men in ambush to rise, Xen. 2. to make a tribe emigrate, to remove or expel, Hdt., Soph. 3. to depopulate, destroy, πόλιν Hdt., Eur., etc. 4. ἐξ. θηρία to rouse them from their lair, Xen. II. intr. in Pass., with aor2, perf. and plup. act.: 1. to stand up from one's seat, Hdt., etc.; to rise to speak, Soph.; from ambush, Eur., Thuc.; from bed, Eur. 2. c. gen. to arise and depart from, emigrate from, Hdt.:—absol. to break up, depart, Thuc., etc. 3. to be driven out from one's home, to be forced to emigrate, Hdt., Aesch. 4. of places, to be depopulated, Hdt., Eur.

εξανοιγω.def: ἐξανοίγω fut. ξω to lay open, Ar.

εξαντλεω.def: ἐξαντλέω fut. ήσω 1. to draw out water:—metaph. to endure to the end, see out, Lat. exantlare, exhaurire, Eur. 2. metaph. also to rob, plunder, Luc.

εξανυω.def: ἐξανύω attic -ανύτω fut. ύσω 1. to accomplish, fulfil, make effectual, Il., Soph.:—Mid. to accomplish or finish for oneself, Eur. 2. to finish or dispatch, i. e. kill, Lat. conficere, Il. 3. of Time and Distance, to bring to an end, finish, accomplish, βίοτον Soph.; δρόμον Eur.:—absol. to finish one's way to a place, arrive at it, ἐς or ἐπὶ τόπον Hdt.; also c. acc. loci, Soph., Eur. 4. c. inf. to manage to do, id. 5. Mid. to obtain, τι παρά τινος id.

εξαπαλαιστοσ.def: ἑξᾱ-πάλαιστος, ον (παλαιστή) of six hands-breadth, Hdt.

εξαπαλλασσω.gloss: to set free from, remove from
εξαπαλλασσω.def: ἐξαπαλλάσσω attic -ττω fut. ξω to set free from, remove from, κακῶν Eur.:—Pass. to ged rid of, escape from, Hdt., Thuc.

εξαπαρταομαι.def: ἐξαπαρτάομαι Pass. to hang from or on, c. gen., Luc.

εξαπαταω.def: ἐξαπατάω ionic imperf. ἐξαπάτασκον fut. ήσω Pass., fut. -απατηθήσομαι or in mid. form -απατήσομαι to deceive or beguile thoroughly, Hom., Hdt., etc.:— also, ἐξ. τινά τι in a thing, Xen.

εξαπατη.def: ἐξ-ᾰπάτη, ἡ, gross deceit, Hes., Xen.

εξαπατητεοσ.def: ἐξαπατητέος Verbal Adj. of ἐξαπατάω one must deceive, Plat.

εξαπατητικοσ.def: ἐξᾰπᾰτητικός, ή, όν calculated to deceive, Xen.

εξαπατυλλω.def: ἐξαπατύλλω (Comic Dim. of ἐξαπατάω) to cheat a little, humbug, Ar.

εξαπαφισκω.def: ἐξαπαφίσκω (epic form of ἐξαπατάω) Hes. aor2 ἐξήπᾰφον Hes. subj. ἐξαπάφω part. ἐξαπαφών part. ἐξαπαφών, Od., etc. 3rd sg. aor2 mid. opt. ἐξαπάφοιτο

εξαπεδοσ.def: ἑξά-πεδος, ον (πούς) six feet long, Hdt.

εξαπειδον.def: ἐξαπεῖδον inf. -απιδεῖν (aor2 without any pres. ἐξαφοράω) in use, to observe from afar, Soph.

εξαπηχυσ.def: ἑξάπηχυς six cubits long, Hdt., Xen.

εξαπιναιοσ.def: ἐξαπίναιος, η, ον (= ἐξαιφνίδιος, Xen.) (adv. -ως Thuc.) (from ἐξᾰπῐ́νης) sudden, unexpected.

εξαπλασιοσ.def: ἑξαπλάσιος six times as large as, τινος Hdt.

εξαπλεθροσ.def: ἑξά-πλεθρος, ον (πλέθρον) six πλέθρα long, i. e. about 1200 feet, Hdt.

εξαποβαινω.def: ἐξαποβαίνω fut. -βήσομαι to step out of, νηός Od.

εξαποδυνω.def: ἐξαποδύνω to put off, εἵματα Od.

εξαπολισ.def: Ἑξάπολις a League of six cities, of the Asiatic Dorians, Hdt.

εξαπολλυμι.def: ἐξαπόλλυμι fut. -ολέσω attic -ολῶ I. to destroy utterly, Trag., etc. II. Mid., with perf. 2 ἐξαπόλωλα, aor2 ἐξαπωλόμην: — to perish utterly out of a place, c. gen., Hom., Aesch.:—absol. to perish utterly, Hdt.

εξαπονεομαι.def: ἐξαπονέομαι Pass. to return out of, Il.

εξαπονιζω.def: ἐξαπονίζω fut. -νίψω to wash thoroughly, Od.

εξαπορεω.def: ἐξαπορέω to be in great doubt or difficulty: so in Mid. and Pass., NTest., Plut.

εξαποστελλω.def: ἐξαποστέλλω fut. -στελῶ to send quite away:—Pass. to be dispatched, Philipp. ap. Dem.

εξαποτινω.def: ἐξαποτίνω to satisfy in full, Il.

εξαποφθειρω.def: ἐξαποφθείρω fut. -φθερῶ to destroy utterly, Aesch., Soph.

εξαπτω.def: ἐξάπτω fut. ψω I. to fasten from, i. e. to, a thing, c. gen., Hom., Eur.; τι ἔκ τινος Hdt. 2. metaph., ἐξ. στόματος λιτάς to let prayers fall from one's mouth, Eur. 3. ἐξ. τί τινι to place upon, id. II. Mid. to hang on, Il. 2. to hang a thing to oneself, carry it about one, wear, Eur.

εξαπωθεω.def: ἐξαπωθέω fut. -ώσω to thrust away, Eur.

εξαραομαι.def: ἐξαράομαι Dep. to utter curses, Soph.

εξαρασσω.def: ἐξαράσσω attic -ττω fut. ξω I. to dash out, shatter, Od., Ar. II. c. acc. pers. to assail furiously, id.

εξαργεω.def: ἐξαργέω fut. ήσω to be quite torpidPass. to be quite neglected, Soph.

εξαργυριζω.def: ἐξαργυρίζω fut. σω to turn into money, Thuc., Dem.

εξαρεσκομαι.def: ἐξαρέσκομαι fut. έσομαι 1. Dep. to make oneself acceptable, Xen. 2. c. acc. pers. to win over, Dem.

εξαριθμεω.def: ἐξαριθμέω fut. ήσω I. to count throughout, number, Lat. enumerare, Hdt., attic II. to count out, pay in ready money, Lat. numeratim solvere, Dem.

εξαρκεω.gloss: to be quite enough for, suffice for
εξαρκεω.def: ἐξαρκέω fut. έσω I. of objects, to be quite enough for, suffice for, τινί Soph., Plat., etc.; πρός τι Xen.: absol. to suffice, be sufficient, Eur., Dem. 2. impers., ἐξαρκεῖ it is enough for, suffices for, c. dat. pers., Hdt., attic II. of persons, to be satisfied with, to be a match for, c. dat., Eur.:—c. part. to be content with having, id.

εξαρκησ.def: ἐξαρκής, ές (from ἐξαρκέω) enough, sufficient, Aesch., Soph.

εξαρκουντωσ.def: ἐξαρκούντως (adverb from part. pres. of ἐξαρκέω,) enough, sufficiently, Ar.

εξαρνεομαι.def: ἐξαρνέομαι fut. ήσομαι aor1 ἐξηρνησάμην and ἐξηρνήθην Dep.:— to deny utterly, Hdt., Eur.

εξαρνησισ.def: ἐξάρνησις, εως (from ἐξαρνέομαι) a denying, denial, Plat.

εξαρνητικοσ.def: ἐξαρνητικός, ή, όν (from ἐξαρνέομαι) apt at denying, negative, Ar.

εξαρνοσ.def: ἔξ-αρνος, ον (ἀρνέομαι) denying; ἔξαρνός εἰμι or γίγνομαι = ἐξαρνέομαι, Ar., etc.; foll. by μή c. inf., ἔξ. ἦν μὴ ἀποκτεῖναι he denied that he had killed, Hdt., etc.

εξαρπαζω.def: ἐξαρπάζω fut. ξω fut. σω, also -άσομαι aor1 ἐξήρπαξα or -ασα I. to snatch away from a place, c. gen., Od.; τι παρά τινος Hdt.; τι ἐκ χερῶν τινος Eur.:— to rescue, Il.:—Pass., οἱ ἐξηρπασμένοι the captured ones, Soph. II. to tear out, Ar.

εξαρταω.gloss: to hang upon, to make dependent upon
εξαρταω.def: ἐξαρτάω fut. ήσω I. to hang upon, to make dependent upon, c. gen., Plut.: also in Mid., Eur. II. Pass., fut. in mid. form -αρτήσομαι, perf. -ήρτημαι: — to be hung upon, hang upon, χειρός id. 2. to depend upon, be dependent upon, be attached to, σοῦ γὰρ ἐξηρτήμεθα id. 3. of countries, to border upon, τινος Plut. 4. to be hung up or exposed to view, Thuc. 5. perf. pass. part., c. acc. rei, having a thing hung on one, be furnished with, Ar., Aeschin.

εξαρτιζω.def: ἐξαρτίζω fut. attic ιῶ to complete, finish, τὰς ἡμέρας NTest.:—Pass. to be thoroughly prepared or furnished, id.:—Mid. to provide oneself with, τι Luc.

εξαρτυω.gloss: to get ready, equip thoroughly, fit out
εξαρτυω.def: ἐξαρτύω fut. ύσω to get ready, equip thoroughly, fit out, Eur., Thuc.:—Mid. to get ready for oneself, fit out, id.: c. inf., ἐξαρτύεται γαμεῖν Aesch.:— Pass. to be got ready, πάντα σφι ἐξήρτυτο Hdt.:—in perf. pass. part., equipt, harnessed, Eur.; c. dat. rei, furnished or provided with, Hdt., Aesch., etc.

εξαρχοσ.def: ἔξ-αρχος, ὁ, ἡ, 1. a leader, beginner, Lat. auctor, Il. 2. the leader of a chorus, Lat. coryphaeus, Dem.

εξαρχω.gloss: to begin with, make a beginning of
εξαρχω.def: ἐξάρχω fut. ξω 1. to begin with, make a beginning of, Lat. auctor esse, c. gen., ἐξῆρχε γόοιο Il., etc.:—so in Mid., ἐξήρχετο βουλῆς Od. 2. c. acc., βουλὰς ἐξάρχων Il.;—also ἐξάρχειν or ἐξάρχεσθαι παιᾶνά τινι to begin a hymn to one, address it to him, Xen.

εξασ.def: ἑξάς, άδος, (ἕξ) the number six, Plut., etc.

εξασκεω.def: ἐξασκέω fut. ήσω I. to adorn, deck out, equip, Soph.;c. dupl. acc., ἁγώ νιν ἐξήσκησα with which I equipped him, Eur. II. to train or teach thoroughly, τινά Plat. 2. to practise, τι Plut.

εξαστραπτω.def: ἐξαστράπτω fut. ψω to flash as with lightning, NTest.

εξατιμαζω.def: ἐξατιμάζω fut. σω to dishonour utterly, Soph.

εξαυαινω.def: ἐξαυαίνω fut. ᾰνῶ to dry quite up, Hdt.

εξαυδαω.def: ἐξαυδάω fut. ήσω to speak out, Il., Soph.:—so in Mid., Aesch.

εξαυλιζομαι.gloss: to leave one's quarters, to go out of camp
εξαυλιζομαι.def: ἐξαυλίζομαι fut. ίσομαι Dep. to leave one's quarters, to go out of camp into villages, Xen.

εξαυτησ.gloss: at the very point of time, at once
εξαυτησ.def: ἐξαυτῆς for ἐξ αὐτῆς [τῆς ὥρας], at the very point of time, at once, Theogn.

εξαυτισ.def: ἐξαῦτις I. over again, once more, anew, Il. II. of place, back again, backwards, id.

εξαυτομολεω.def: ἐξαυτομολέω fut. ήσω to desert from a place, Ar.

εξαυχεω.def: ἐξαυχέω fut. ήσω aor1 -ηύχησα to boast loudly, profess, Trag.

εξαυω.def: ἐξαύω fut. σω to cry out, Soph.

εξαφαιρεω.def: ἐξαφαιρέω to take right away: in Mid., aor. 2 -αφειλόμην Od.

εξαφιημι.def: ἐξαφίημι fut. -αφήσω I. to send forth, discharge, Xen. II. to set free from labour, c. gen., Soph.

εξαφισταμαι.def: ἐξαφίσταμαι Pass., with aor2, perf., and plup. act., to depart or withdraw from, τινος Soph., Eur.

εξαφριζομαι.def: ἐξαφρίζομαι Mid. to throw off by foaming:—metaph. from a horse, ἐξαφρίζεσθαι μένος Aesch.

εξαφυω.def: ἐξαφύω (ἀφύσσω) to draw forth liquor, Od.

εξαχειρ.def: ἑξά-χειρ, ειρος, ὁ, ἡ, six-handed, Luc.

εξεγγυαω.def: ἐξεγγυάω fut. ήσω to free a person by giving bail, Dem.:—Pass. to be bailed, id.

εξεγγυησισ.def: ἐξεγγύησις, εως (from ἐξεγγυάω) a giving of bail, Dem.

εξεγειρω.def: ἐξεγείρω fut. ερῶ 1. to awaken, Soph.:—Pass. to be awaked, wake up, Hdt., etc.; syncop. aor2 ἐξηγρόμην Ar.; epic 3rd pl. ἐξέγροντο Theocr.; perf. 2 ἐξεγρήγορα Ar. 2. to raise from the dead, Aesch. 3. metaph. to awake, arouse, bring on, Eur.

εξεδρα.def: ἐξ-έδρα, ἡ, Lat. exhedra, a hall or arcade in the gymnasia, a sort of cloister, Eur.

εξεδροσ.def: ἔξ-εδρος, ον (ἕδρα) I. away from home, Soph. 2. c. gen. out of, away from, Eur.: metaph., ἔξεδροι φρενῶν λόγοι insensate words, id. II. of birds of omen, ἔξ. χώραν ἔχειν to be in an unlucky quarter, Ar.

εξειδον.def: ἐξεῖδον inf. -ιδεῖν aor2 in use of the pres. ἐξοράω to look out, see far, Il.: also imperat. mid., ἐξιδοῦ see well to it, Soph.

εξεικαζω.def: ἐξεικάζω fut. άσω to make like, to adapt, Xen.:—Pass., ἐξείκαστό τινι was like it, id.; part. perf., οὐδὲν ἐξῃκασμένα not mere semblances, but the things themselves, Aesch.; στέρνα ἐξῃκασμένα portrayed, Eur.; οὐκ ἐξῃκασμένος not represented by a portrait-mask, Ar.

εξειλλω.def: ἐξείλλω I. to disentangle, Xen. II. to keep forcibly from, debar from, τινά τινος Dem. B. ἐξειλέω 1. to unfold, Luc.

εξειλυω.def: ἐξειλύω to unwrap:—Pass. to glide along, aor1 ἐξειλύσθην, Theocr.

εξειμι.def: ἔξειμι (εἶμι ibo) epic 2nd sg. ἔξεισθα attic imper. ἔξει (attic imper. ἔξει for ἔξιθι) imperf. ἐξῄειν ionic ἐξήϊα (serving as attic fut. of ἐξέρχομαι, but with imperf. ἐξῄειν, ionic ἐξήϊα) I. to go out, come out of the house, Hom.; c. gen. loci, Od., Soph.; ἐξ. ἐκ τῶν ἱππέων to leave the knights, Hdt.; εἰς ἔλεγχον ἐξιέναι to come forth to the trial, Soph. 2. to march out with an army, Thuc., Xen.:—c. acc. cogn. to go out on an expedition or enterprise, Soph., Eur., etc. 3. to come forward on the stage, Ar. II. of Time or incidents, to come to an end, expire, Hdt., Soph.

εξειπον.gloss: to speak out, tell out, declare
εξειπον.def: ἐξεῖπον inf. -ειπεῖν aor2 in use of ἐξαγορεύω, ἐξερέω (q. v.) 1. to speak out, tell out, declare, Lat. effari, Hom., Thuc. 2. c. dupl. acc. to tell something of a person, Soph., Eur.

εξειργασμενωσ.def: ἐξειργασμένως (adverb part. perf. pass. of ἐξεργάζομαι,) carefully, accurately, fully, Plut.

εξειρω.def: ἐξείρω aor1 -εῖρα I. to put forth, Lat. exsero, τὴν χεῖρα Hdt.; τὸ κέντρον Ar. II. to pull out, τὴν γλῶσσαν id.

εξελασισ.def: ἐξέλᾰσις, εως I. a driving out, expulsion, Hdt. II. intr. a marching out, expedition, id., Xen. (from ἐξελαύνω)

εξελαυνω.def: ἐξελαύνω fut. -ελάσω contr. -ελῶ perf. -ελήλᾰκα epic part. ἐξελάων inf. ἐξελάαν I. occurs in Hom.:— to drive out from, ἄντρου ἐξήλασε μῆλα Od.; absol. to drive afield, of a shepherd, id.:—esp. to drive out or expel from a place, id., Aesch., etc. 2. to drive out horses or chariots, Il.: Mid. to drive out one's horses, Theocr.; so, ἐξελαύνειν στρατόν to lead out an army, Hdt.: hence 3. intr. to march out, Hdt.: to drive or ride out, Thuc. II. to knock out, Od. III. to beat out metals, Hdt.

εξελεγκτεοσ.def: ἐξελεγκτέος, η, ον (verb. adj.) to be refuted, Plat. (from ἐξελέγχω)

εξελεγχω.def: ἐξελέγχω fut. ξω I. to convict, confute, refute, Soph., Ar., etc. 2. c. dupl. acc. pers. et rei, to convict one of a thing, Plat.: Pass. to be so convicted of, Dem. 3. with predicate added in part. to convict one of being.., Plat.:—Pass., κἀξελέγχεται κάκιστος ὤν Eur. II. to search out, put to the proof, Aesch.: —Pass., ἦσαν ἐξεληλεγμένοι all had had their sentiments well ascertained, Dem.; ἐξηλέγχθη ἐς τὸ ἀληθές was fully proved to be true, Thuc.

εξελευθερικοσ.def: ἐξελευθερικός of the class of freedmen or their offspring, Lat. libertinus, Plut. (from ἐξελεύθερος)

εξελευθεροσ.def: ἐξ-ελεύθερος, ὁ, ἡ, set at liberty, a freedman, Lat. libertus, libertinus, Cic.

εξελευθεροστομεω.gloss: to be very free of speech
εξελευθεροστομεω.def: ἐξελευθεροστομέω to be very free of speech, Soph.

εξελισσω.def: ἐξελίσσω attic -ττω fut. ξω I. to unroll, Eur.:metaph. to unfold, Lat. explicare, id. 2. of any rapid motion, ἴχνος ἐξ. ποδός to evolve the mazy dance, id.:—hence intr. to wheel about, Plut. II. as military term, = ἀναπτύσσειν, Lat. explicare, to extend the front by bringing up the rear men, to deploy, Xen. 2. to draw off, Plut.

εξελκτεοσ.def: ἐξελκτέος, ον (verb. adj.) one must drag along, Eur. (from ἐξέλκω)

εξελκω.def: ἐξέλκω aor1 -είλκῠσα 3rd sg. pass. subj. -ελκυσθῇ I. to draw or drag out, Il. 2. to drag out from a place, c. gen., Od., Eur. II. to drag along, Soph., Eur.

εξελληνιζω.gloss: to turn into Greek, to trace to a Greek origin
εξελληνιζω.def: ἐξελληνίζω fut. σω to turn into Greek, to trace to a Greek origin, Plut.

εξεμεω.def: ἐξεμέω fut. έσω 1. to vomit forth, disgorge, Od.:—metaph. to disgorge ill-gotten gear, Ar. 2. absol. to vomit, be sick, id.

εξεμπεδοω.gloss: to keep quite firm, strictly observe
εξεμπεδοω.def: ἐξεμπεδόω to keep quite firm, strictly observe, Xen.

εξεμπολαω.def: ἐξεμπολάω ionic -έω fut. ήσω I. to traffic, κέρδος ἐξ. to drive a gainful trade, Soph.; ἐξημπόλημαι I am bought and sold, betrayed, id. II. to sell off, Hdt.

εξεναιρω.def: ἐξεναίρω to kill outright, aor2 inf. ἐξενᾰρεῖν Hes.

εξεναριζω.def: ἐξεναρίζω fut. ίξω 1. to strip or spoil a foe slain in fight, Il.; τεύχεα ἐξ. to strip off his arms, id. 2. to kill, slay, Hom.

εξεπαδω.def: ἐξεπᾴδω fut. -ᾴσομαι to charm away, Plat.:—Pass., ἐξεπᾴδεσθαι φύσιν to be charmed out of their nature, Soph.

εξεπευχομαι.def: ἐξεπεύχομαι Dep. to boast loudly that, c. inf., Soph.

εξεπισταμαι.def: ἐξεπίσταμαι Dep. to know thoroughly, know well, Hdt., attic; c. inf. to know well how to do, Soph.

εξεπιτηδεσ.def: ἐξεπίτηδες of set purpose, Ar., Plat.: with malice prepense, Dem.

εξεραμα.def: ἐξέρᾱμα, ατος, τό, a vomit, thing vomited, NTest. (from ἐξεράω)

εξεραω.def: ἐξεράω aor1 ἐξέρᾱσα to disgorge, Ar.; φέρ’ ἐξεράσω τὰς ψήφους let me disgorge the ballots from the urn (in order to count them), id.; ἐξέρα τὸ ὕδωρ pour it out, Dem.

εξεργαζομαι.gloss: to work out, make completely, finish off, bring to perfection
εξεργαζομαι.def: ἐξεργάζομαι fut. -άσομαι perf. -είργασμαι ionic -έργασμαι (both in act. and pass. sense) I. to work out, make completely, finish off, bring to perfection, Hdt., attic 2. to accomplish, perform, achieve a work, Soph.; κακὸν ἐξ. τινα to work him mischief, Hdt.:—as Pass., ἔργον ἐστὶν ἐξειργασμένον Aesch.; ἐπ’ ἐξεργασμένοισι after the deed had been done, Hdt. 3. to work at: as Pass., ἀγροὶ εὖ ἐξεργασμένοι well cultivated lands, id.; [ἡ γῆ] ἐξείργασται Thuc. II. to undo, destroy, overwhelm, ruin, Hdt., Eur.:—as Pass., ἐξειργάσμεθα we are undone, id.

εξεργαστικοσ.def: ἐξεργαστικός, ή, όν (from ἐξεργάζομαι) able to accomplish, τινος Xen.

εξεργω.def: ἐξέργω attic ἐξ-είργω 1. to shut out from a place, debar, Hdt., etc.; ἐξείργειν τινα χθονός Eur.; ἐκ τοῦ θεάτρου Dem.:—Pass., ἐξείργεσθαι πάντων Thuc. 2. to debar, hinder, prevent, preclude, Soph., Eur. 3. to force:—Pass. to be constrained, Hdt., Thuc.

εξερεεινω.def: ἐξερεείνω I. epic Verb, 1. c. acc. rei, to inquire into, Od. 2. c. acc. pers. to inquire after, id.: absol. to make inquiry, Il.; so in Mid., id. II. to search thoroughly, Od.

εξερειπω.def: ἐξερείπω to strike off: intr. in aor, 2 ἐξήρῐπον, inf. ἐξερῐπεῖν, to fall to earth, Il.; χαίτη ζεύγλης ἐξεριποῦσα the mane streaming downwards from the yoke, id.

εξερευγομαι.def: ἐξερεύγομαι Pass., of rivers, to empty themselves, Hdt.

εξερευναω.def: ἐξερευνάω fut. ήσω to search out, examine, Soph., Eur.

εξερεω.gloss: I will speak out, tell out, utter aloud
εξερεω.def: ἐξερέω attic contr. -ερῶ (fut. of ἐξεῖπον) I will speak out, tell out, utter aloud, Hom., Soph.: so in perf. act. ἐξείρηκα id.; 3rd sg. plup. pass. ἐξείρητο id.; fut. pass. ἐξειρήσεται id.

ἐξερέω 1. to inquire into a thing, Od.; so in Mid., id. 2. to inquire of a person, id.; and in Mid., id. II. to search through, id. B. Dep.: ἐξέρομαι ionic -είρομαι fut. -ερήσομαι aor2 -ηρόμην inf. -ερέσθαι 1. to inquire into a thing, Od., Soph. 2. to inquire of a person, Il., Soph.

εξερημοω.gloss: to make quite desolate, leave destitute, abandon
εξερημοω.def: ἐξερημόω fut. ώσω to make quite desolate, leave destitute, abandon, Soph., Eur.; ἐξ. γένυν δράκοντος making it destitute of teeth, id.:—Pass. to be left destitute, Ar.

εξεριζω.def: ἐξερίζω fut. σω to be contumacious, Plut.

εξεριστησ.def: ἐξεριστής, οῦ, (from ἐξερίζω) a stubborn disputant, Eur.

εξερμηνευω.def: ἐξερμηνεύω fut. σω to interpret accurately, Luc.

εξερπω.def: ἐξέρπω aor1 -είρπῠσα 1. to creep out of, ἔκ τινος Ar. 2. absol. to creep out or forth, Soph., Ar.; of an army, οὐ ταχὺ ἐξέρπει Xen.

εξερρω.def: ἐξέρρω only in imperat., ἔξερρε γαίας away out of the land! Eur.

εξερυκω.def: ἐξερύκω fut. ξω to ward off, repel, Soph.

εξερυω.def: ἐξερύω ionic -ειρύω aor1 -είρῠσα epic -έρῠσα and -είρυσσα ionic 3rd sg. aor1 -ερύσασκε to draw out of, c. gen., Il.; ἰχθύας ἔκτοσθε θαλάσσης ἐξέρυσαν Od.:—also, to snatch out of, ἐξείρυσε χειρὸς τόξον Il.: to tear out, Od.

εξερχομαι.def: ἐξέρχομαι fut. -ελεύσομαι (in attic ἔξειμι supplies the fut., as also the imperf. ἐξῄειν) aor2 ἐξῆλθον I. Dep.:— to go or come out of, c. gen. loci, Hom., Hdt., etc.; of an actor, to come out on the stage, Ar.:—also c. acc., ἐξ. τὴν χώρην Hdt.:—absol. to go away, march off, Il.: also, to march out, go forth, ἐπί τινα Hdt.:—c. acc. cogn. to go out on an expedition, Xen.: to go through a work, Soph. 2. ἐξ. εἰς ἔλεγχον to stand forth and come to the trial, Eur.: to turn out so and so, Soph. 3. c. acc. rei, to execute, Thuc. II. of Time, to come to an end, expire, Hdt., Soph. III. of prophecies, dreams, events, to be accomplished, come true, Hdt.; ὀρθὸν ἐξ. to come out right, Soph.; μὴ ἐξέλθῃ σαφής lest he turn out a true prophet, id.

εξερωεω.def: ἐξερωέω fut. ήσω to swerve from the course, Il.

εξεσθιω.def: ἐξεσθίω fut. -έδομαι perf. -εδήδοκα aor2 -έφᾰγον to eat away, eat up, Ar.

εξεσια.def: ἐξεσία, ἡ, (ἐξίημι) a sending out, mission, embassy, Hom.

εξεσισ.def: ἔξεσις, εως (ἐξίημι) a dismissal, divorce, Hdt.

εξεστι.gloss: it is allowed, it is in one's power, is possible
εξεστι.def: ἔξεστι imperat. ἐξέστω subj. ἔξῃ opt. ἐξείη inf. ἐξεῖναι part. ἐξόν imperf. ἐξῆν fut. ἐξέσται opt. ἐξέσοιτο (impers., the only forms in use of ἔξ-ειμι) it is allowed, it is in one's power, is possible, c. inf., Hdt.: c. dat. pers. et inf., id., attic; ἔξ. σοι ἀνδρὶ γενέσθαι Xen.:— c. acc. pers. et inf., Ar.:—part. neut. absol., ἐξόν since it was possible, Hdt., Aesch., etc.

εξεταζω.def: ἐξετάζω I. to examine well or closely, inquire into, scrutinise, review, Theogn., attic 2. of troops, to inspect, review, Thuc., etc.:—generally, to pass in review, enumerate, Dem. II. to examine or question a person closely, Hdt., Soph., etc. III. to estimate, compare, τι πρός τι one thing by or with another, id. IV. to prove by testing, of gold, id.:—in Pass. with part., ἐξετάζεται παρών he is proved to have been present, Plat.; ἐξετάζεσθαι φίλος (sc. ὤν) Eur.; c. gen., τῶν ἐχθρῶν ἐξετάζεσθαι to be found in the number of the enemies, Dem. 2. to present oneself, appear, id.

εξετασισ.def: ἐξέτᾰσις, εως (ἐξετάζω) 1. a close examination, scrutiny, review, Thuc., Plat., etc. 2. a military inspection or review, Thuc., Xen.

εξεταστεοσ.def: ἐξεταστέος (Verb. Adj. of ἐξετάζω) one must scrutinise, Plat.

εξεταστησ.def: ἐξεταστής, οῦ, (ἐξετάζω) an examiner, inquirer, Plut.: at Athens, a paymaster, Aeschin.

εξεταστικοσ.def: ἐξεταστικός, ή, όν (ἐξετάζω) I. capable of examining into, τινός Xen.:—absol. inquiring, id.:—adv. -κῶς, Dem. II. ἐξ. (sc. ἀργύριον), the salary of an ἐξεταστής, id.

εξετησ.def: ἑξ-έτης, ες (ἔτος) six years old, Il., Ar.

εξετι.def: ἐξέτι prep. with gen., even from, ἐξέτι πατρῶν even from the fathers' time, Od.

εξευλαβεομαι.def: ἐξευλαβέομαι fut. ήσομαι to guard carefully against, τι Eur., Plat.

εξευμαριζω.def: ἐξευμαρίζω fut. σω I. to make light or easy, Eur. II. Mid. to prepare, Lat. expedire, id.

εξευρεσισ.def: ἐξεύρεσις, εως 1. a searching out, search, Hdt. 2. a finding out, invention, id. (from ἐξευρίσκω)

εξευρετεοσ.def: ἐξευρετέος, η, ον (from ἐξευρίσκω) (verb. adj.) I. to be discovered, Ar. II. ἐξευρετέον, one must find out, Plat.

εξευρημα.gloss: a thing found out, an invention
εξευρημα.def: ἐξεύρημα, ατος, τό, (from ἐξευρίσκω) a thing found out, an invention, Hdt., Aesch.

εξευρισκω.def: ἐξευρίσκω fut. -ευρήσω aor2 -εῦρον 1. to find out, discover, Il., Thuc., etc. 2. to invent, Hdt., Aesch. 3. simply to find, Soph. 4. to seek out, search after, Hdt. 5. to find out, win, get, procure, Soph.

εξευτελιζω.def: ἐξευτελίζω fut. σω (εὐτελής) to disparage greatly, Plut.

εξευτρεπιζω.def: ἐξευτρεπίζω to make quite ready, Eur.

εξευχομαι.def: ἐξεύχομαι fut. -ξομαι I. Dep. to boast aloud, proclaim, Aesch. II. to pray earnestly, id., Eur.

εξεφιημι.def: ἐξεφίημι strengthd. for ἐφίημι Mid. ἐξεφίεμαι to enjoin, command, Soph., Eur.

εξεχω.def: ἐξέχω fut. -έξω 1. to stand out or project from, τινός Ar. 2. absol. to stand out, appear, id.

εξεψω.def: ἐξέψω fut. -εψήσω to boil thoroughly, Hdt.

εξηβοσ.def: ἔξ-ηβος, ον (ἥβη) past one's youth, Aesch.

εξηγεομαι.def: ἐξηγέομαι fut. ήσομαι Dep. I. to be leader of others, c. gen., Il.:—also c. acc. pers. to lead, direct, govern, Thuc. II. to go first, lead the way, Hhymn., Hdt. 2. c. dat. pers. to shew one the way, go before, lead, id., Soph., etc. 3. c. gen. rei, to conduct a business, Xen. 4. ἐξ. εἰς τὴν Ἑλλάδα to lead an army into Greece, id. III. like Lat. praeire verbis, to prescribe or dictate a form of words, Eur., Dem.:—generally to prescribe, order, Hdt., Aesch., etc.:— to prescribe or expound the form to be observed in religious ceremonies, Hdt., attic IV. to tell at length, relate in full, Hdt., attic

εξηγησισ.def: ἐξήγησις, εως (from ἐξηγέομαι) I. a statement, narrative, Thuc. II. explanation, interpretation, Plat.

εξηγητησ.gloss: one who leads on, an adviser
εξηγητησ.def: ἐξηγητής, οῦ, (from ἐηγέομαι) I. one who leads on, an adviser, Lat. auctor, Hdt., Dem. II. an expounder, interpreter, of oracles, dreams, omens, and sacred customs, Hdt., Plat., etc.

εξηγητικοσ.def: ἐξηγητικός, ή, όν of or for interpretation, Plut.

εξηκονταετησ.def: ἑξηκοντα-έτης, ες (ἔτος) sixty years old, Mimnerm.

εξηκονταταλαντια.gloss: a company contributing a sum of
εξηκονταταλαντια.def: ἑξηκοντα-τᾰλαντία, ἡ, (τάλαντον) a company contributing a sum of 60 talents to the state, Dem.

εξηκοστοσ.def: ἑξηκοστός, ή, όν (ἑξήκοντα) sixtieth, Hdt., etc.

εξηκω.def: ἐξήκω fut. ξω I. to have reached a certain point, Soph., Plat. II. of Time, to have run out or expired, to be over, Hdt., Soph., etc. 2. of prophecies, dreams, etc. to turn out true, id., Hdt.

εξηλατοσ.def: ἐξήλᾰτος, ον (ἐξελαύνω) beaten out, of metal, Il.

εξηλυσισ.def: ἐξήλῠσις, εως (ἐξήλῠθον, aor2 of ἐξέρχομαι) a way out, outlet, Hdt.

εξημαρ.gloss: for six days, six days long
εξημαρ.def: ἑξῆμαρ for six days, six days long, Od.

εξημεροω.def: ἐξημερόω fut. ώσω to tame or reclaim quite, Hdt., Eur.:—metaph. to soften, humanise, Plut.

εξημερωσισ.def: ἐξημέρωσις, εως (from ἐξημερόω) a reclaiming, humanising, Plut.

εξημοιβοσ.def: ἐξημοιβός, όν (ἐξαμείβω) serving for change, εἵματα δ’ ἐξημοιβά changes of raiment, Od.

εξηρετμοσ.def: ἑξ-ήρετμος, ον (ἐρετμός) of six banks of oars, Anth.

εξηρησ.def: ἑξ-ήρης, ες (⁎ἄρω) with six banks of oars, ναῦς, Plut.

εξησ.gloss: one after another, in order, in a row
εξησ.def: ἑξῆς (ἕξω,) fut. of ἔχω I. one after another, in order, in a row, Hom.: in order, in a regular manner, Plat. 2. of Time, thereafter, next, Aesch., etc.; ἡ ἑξῆς ἡμέρα the next day, NTest. II. c. gen. next to, Ar.; τούτων ἑξῆς next after this, Dem.; c. dat. next to, Plat.

εξηχεω.def: ἐξηχέω fut. ήσω to sound forth:—Pass. to be made known, NTest.

εξιαομαι.def: ἐξιάομαι fut. -άσομαι ionic -ήσομαι Dep. to cure thoroughly, Hdt., Plat.

εξιδιω.def: ἐξιδίω fut. ίσω to exsude, Ar.

εξιδρυω.def: ἐξιδρύω fut. ύσω to make to sit down, Soph.

εξιημι.def: ἐξίημι fut. -ήσω epic aor2 inf. ἐξ-έμεναι, -έμεν I. to send out, let one go out, Od.; γόου ἐξ ἔρον εἵην had dismissed, satisfied the desire of lamentation, Il.; ἐξιέναι πάντα κάλων (v. sub κάλως):— to take out, Hdt. 2. intr. of rivers, to discharge themselves, id., Thuc. II. Mid. to put off from oneself, get rid of, πόσιος καὶ ἐδητύος ἐξ ἔρον ἕντο Hom. 2. to send from oneself, divorce, γυναῖκα Hdt.

εξιθυνω.def: ἐξιθύνω fut. ῠνῶ to make straight, Il.

εξικετευω.def: ἐξικετεύω fut. σω to intreat earnestly, Soph.

εξικνεομαι.def: ἐξικνέομαι fut. -ίξομαι aor2 -ικόμην Dep. I. to reach, arrive at a place, c. acc., Hom., Trag. II. c. acc. pers. to come to as a suppliant, Od. 2. c. acc. rei, to arrive at or reach an object, to complete, accomplish, Thuc.; so c. gen., Eur. 3. absol. to reach, Hdt., Xen.:—of mental operations, ὅσον δυνατός εἰμι ἐξικέσθαι so far as I can get by inquiry, Hdt. b. of things, to be sufficient, Plat.

εξιλασκομαι.def: ἐξιλάσκομαι fut. άσομαι epic άσσομαι Dep. to propitiate, Orac. ap. Hdt., Xen.

εξιππαζομαι.def: ἐξιππάζομαι fut. άσομαι Dep. to ride out or away, Plut.

εξισ.def: ἕξις, εως (ἕξω, fut. of ἔχω) I. a having, possession, Plat. II. (intr.) a habit of body, esp. a good habit, Xen., Plat. 2. a habit of mind, id.
